Friend, Election Day is practically here! Make a plan to vote. Now is also the time to call your family and friends. Encourage them to vote for the Schimpf-Schofield Team.
When we refer to "A New Start for Illinois," we aren't just talking about our policy agenda. We are also talking about a new type of politics where leaders bring us together, recognizing that the strength of Illinois is its people, not its dysfunctional government. Change starts with electing leaders who are not beholden to the same out of touch mega-donors, political operatives, or special interest groups. Illinois deserves a Governor and Lieutenant Governor who will listen, learn, and lead in a way that brings us together.
WE ARE THAT TEAM and we ask for your trust and your vote on June 28th!
* * *
**Media Coverage** You can watch the WTTW candidate forum by clicking on the picture below. [](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=zXzFprLJX0dmCyqFmUf_bpvGQA101s1FlCaDngiEhBwB6KU_XwWAu2eTSXlrz585aYyxFaYStSAkKMvGuLUutSxXdFpgKdWWWApHOf7VcUV1mndZPcYHVXn6XILl2gAk&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_22nd_from_the_trail&n=2) You can listen to my WJPF radio interview by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=v4cHwepctZ_HmTnYxcHT9sr5FncMCOHOlMrAdxIH_rkqJeAf5Wu0ubLsUixFtxbeOq4AdCq0YU_Rbip3oUXWW2J3JZHY0MSIIoBpGp5CiYtyxn9yvbHMlCVw5BgHdA2F&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_22nd_from_the_trail&n=3). You can listen to my WHCO radio interview by clicking [HERE](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/r?u=954wJVfXJnGDSMt_j90vIl2I9Mts3vNP7Yqes3Kf2ONtNTcr5m5T408jwd5TDISuLIzirFGoEKjcmAr2gOZcgA&e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=june_22nd_from_the_trail&n=4).
* * *
**Upcoming Events** During the next few days, we will be traveling across the state of Illinois, making our final pitch to voters. If we are near where you live, we'd love to have you come out to one of our stops.

* * *
**Issue Spotlight: Defeating JB Pritzker
** Nothing changes in Illinois unless we defeat JB Pritzker in November. You cannot defeat JB Pritzker unless you have a united Illinois Republican Party behind you--both the suburban moderates and the grassroots conservatives. In 2010 and 2018, a divided Republican Party suffered disappointing losses in the races for Illinois Governor. We have to learn from our mistakes and nominate a team that can unite, not divide, the Illinois Republican Party.
Carolyn and I can unite the Illinois Republican Party. I have the legislative record to earn support from the conservative base. We have the positive message that galvanizes suburban moderates.
That makes us the ONLY team that can defeat JB Pritzker this November! Thank you for reading this e-blast. This is a going to be a low turnout election. Every vote will matter. Please encourage your friends and family to vote in the June 28th Republican Primary for the Schimpf-Schofield team! Semper Fidelis, Paul

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Friend of the Constitution,

The far Left in America is attempting to
rewrite our nation's history and undermine our Constitution-with
a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment.

Today, you're receiving Hillsdale College's
Second Amendment Survey because you're someone who understands
that education is essential to the defense of liberty.

We are reaching and teaching millions of
Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this
without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding.

Could you take a few minutes to complete our
Second Amendment Survey using the secure link below?

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach
and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year
about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights
protected by the Second Amendment.

There is no question that one of the Left's
most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our
liberty is ignorance.

Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing
truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in
1844.

Today our educational outreach efforts
include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty,
such as the Second Amendment.

As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler
observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions
of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first
principles."

This means the Second Amendment is essential
for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of
defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom.

This kind of thinking is foreign to most
college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are
now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an
example…

Not long ago, the University of Virginia
canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day.

Why?

The administration was concerned that firing
guns in honor of those who served their country and did their
part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student
body.

Unfortunately, there are many more such
examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the
ongoing decline in civics education in America.

But instead of just TALKING, it's more
important to DO something about it.

That's why we have been working to expand our
educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty.

And this work continues today.

That's why I would like your answers to our
brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today
at this secure link:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

We believe that an educated citizenry is
essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan
said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from
extinction."

Do you agree? I hope so.

This is why we reach and teach millions of
Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution.
It's also why we need your help today.

As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from
much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

Our independence from the government means
that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of
citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to
liberty.

It also means your gift really matters.

Today, you have a great opportunity to help
preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future
generations.

After completing your Second Amendment
Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous
tax-deductible gift today.

And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll
send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our
thank you.

This hat commemorates our partnership with
USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best
American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and
Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited!

Thank you for your time and attention. I look
forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second
Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take
our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will
only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve
liberty for future generations. Thank you!

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/

Your timely survey answers will help us reach and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year about the importance of liberty-which includes the rights protected by the Second Amendment. There is no question that one of the Left's most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our liberty is ignorance. Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in 1844. Today our educational outreach efforts include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty, such as the Second Amendment. As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler observed in Imprimis, our digest of liberty that reaches millions of Americans: "The Second Amendment is an expression of first principles." This means the Second Amendment is essential for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom. This kind of thinking is foreign to most college and university campuses today, where "safe spaces" are now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here's an example… Not long ago, the University of Virginia canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day. Why? The administration was concerned that firing guns in honor of those who served their country and did their part to defend our freedom would cause "panic" among the student body. Unfortunately, there are many more such examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the ongoing decline in civics education in America. But instead of just TALKING, it's more important to DO something about it. That's why we have been working to expand our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. And this work continues today. That's why I would like your answers to our brief Second Amendment Survey. You can complete the survey today at this secure link: We believe that an educated citizenry is essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan said, "Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction." Do you agree? I hope so. This is why we reach and teach millions of Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution. It's also why we need your help today. As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. Our independence from the government means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. It also means your gift really matters. Today, you have a great opportunity to help preserve liberty-including the Second Amendment-for future generations. After completing your Second Amendment Survey, please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous tax-deductible gift today. And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we'll send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our thank you. This hat commemorates our partnership with USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and Paralympics. But hurry-supplies are limited! Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed Second Amendment Survey. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 P.S. Our Constitution-including the Second Amendment-is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take our Second Amendment Survey at the secure link below. It will only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve liberty for future generations. Thank you! | | **This morning, the US Supreme Court made it substantially easier for people to legally carry a concealed handgun.** Their decision will put _more_ guns on our streets at a time when we're still reeling from mass shootings like the massacre of children in Uvalde and the hate-fueled attack in Buffalo. I've been thinking a lot lately about what Republican leaders have truly been asking for when they insist that the response to our country's gun violence epidemic is _more_ guns**.** When I hear suggestions of fully-armed schools and an ever-increasing number of private citizens secretly carrying guns, as a father of two young boys, I get worried. I've been focused on keeping guns out of the hands of people who mean to do harm and I will always fight against policies that take us backwards and make our communities less safe. I know not everyone agrees with me on what to do about gun violence, but we can't accept near-daily mass shootings as a fact of life. **Progress isn't inevitable but inaction is unacceptable. We can keep ourselves and our communities safe with commonsense gun violence prevention. That's what I'm fighting for – and why our movement exists – to offer a different vision for our future: a world where our children can grow up without the constant threat of gun violence.** _Andy_ |

| | Peter,

Inflation is flattening Minnesota families. There have been warning signs for months now, as grocery store shelves stay empty and basic needs like baby formula were hard to come by. Democrat policies led by Tim Walz and Joe Biden are truly hurting Minnesotans!

What adds insult to injury is that Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan want to GROW government even as family budgets shrink. That's why today, Matt Birk and I have announced our plan to empower families, enhance household budgets, and combat inflation at the State Level! [Our FIT (Fight Inflation Together) Plan](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=4e64c40c0a&e=33b11688c1) uses specific initiatives to tackle the economic hardships so many are facing! [Click here to see the full plan](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=f770bf2fb9&e=33b11688c1) or **click the image below** :

* Get proactive on energy production
* Unleash Minnesotans by not allowing us to be a top-10 taxed state across the board
* Grow the private sector and give workers more money by phasing out the income tax
* Eliminate the rampant abuse and fraud which has cost us hundreds of millions
* Veto all wasteful projects
* Eliminate the Social Security tax
* Veto and reduce unnecessary taxes which increase cost of living
* Veto and reduce regulations which increase cost of living
* Hire competent watchdogs in agencies to keep government spending accountable
* Take proactive steps to increase job growth in Minnesota

New leadership will result in more money for you and your family to spend, save and invest. Minnesota can LEAD in spite of Biden/Walz inflationary policies and we can even fight past them toward prosperity! Under Tim Walz, the state government budget and inflation have been growing, while the average family budget has been shrinking - which is leaving less money to spend on groceries, gas and other needed expenses. There is a better way and we can GROW Minnesota families’ budgets even during economic downturns.

[Join our movement and help us win!](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=1d6e3f62b4&e=33b11688c1)

Dr. Scott Jensen

Derek, my wife, Eve, surprised me yesterday with the birthday card she asked you all to sign, and wow...

Onward,

clean_body: I’ve seen enough. America needs new leadership, and we need it now.| | | Peter, I’ve seen enough. America needs new leadership, and we need it now. Nancy Pelosi, Chuck Schumer, and Joe Biden have left average Americans behind in the dirt for Hollywood fame and glory. I didn’t fight in combat for the American people to give up on them now, Friend. We CAN turn Washington around and make it work for Main Street, but I need your help to get there. When I was on the ground in Afghanistan and Somalia, I saw what real leadership looked like. I served with men and women who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice for our country and charged into action not knowing if they’d make it back. We need leaders who aren’t afraid to give their all when freedom is on the line, and I’m ready to be that leader for you, Friend. I believe in you and our believe in our mission. Now, let’s get to work. name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Prominent Colorado Officials Endorse Erik Aadland
body:
Law & Justice backs Erik for Congress
| | | |
---
|
---
|
# Park County Sheriff & Colorado District Attorney
---
|
---
| (June 17, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Sheriff Tom McGraw and District Attorney Michael Allen.
---
| | |
---|---
|
Sheriff McGraw has a vast law enforcement background spanning 35 years. Beginning as a reserve deputy, he joined the force fulltime at the age of 19. McGraw spent nine years as a patrol deputy, advancing to Corporal within five years and Detective within eight, McGraw's resume includes two years in fraud, five years in homicide, three years in public corruption, and a total of 16 years in narcotics, assisting rural agencies with narcotics, homicide and fraud investigations. McGraw retired at the rank of Inspector, with thousands of hours in training and experience working in conjunction with various law enforcement agencies across the state of Florida.
McGraw is a certified firearms and defensive tactics instructor, and prior SWAT team leader.
In his statement, Sheriff McGraw said:
"Erik Aadland is a man of proven character. That's why it's my pleasure to endorse
him as the best candidate for Congress in Colorado's 7th district. As an elected sheriff and career law enforcement professional, I know what it means to lead teams with discernment and precision. Erik is a leader of the same caliber. The depth and significance of his experience, both in the military and in the energy sector, speak well for his ability to find solutions and build coalitions to effect positive change in Washington. Please join with me in supporting Erik Aadland as our next Congressman. He is ready to stand for our community."

|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am deeply grateful to Sheriff McGraw for his kind endorsement. We agree that stakes are high in today's political climate, and that Coloradans deserve a candidate who knows what it means to defend our Constitution under the most critical of circumstances. Just as I risked my life on the battlefield for our country, I am prepared to do whatever it takes to unfailingly protect our rights and to advocate for our freedoms."
---
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Michael Allen is the 4th Judicial District Attorney. Allen enlisted into the Navy after graduating from Arvada West High School then served as an Aviation Electronics Technician--most recently aboard the USS Carl Vinson--until receiving an Honorable Discharge in 1998. Allen earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Northern Colorado and a law degree from the University of Kansas.

Allen began his legal career as a prosecutor intern in the Johnson County Kansas District Attorney's Office, Kansas Attorney General's Office, and the Douglas County KS District Attorney's Office. He joined the 4th Judicial District Attorney's Office (serving Teller and El Paso Counties) in 2011 and has served the Pikes Peak region in several roles.

Allen was sworn in as the elected District Attorney of Colorado's Fourth Judicial District on January 12, 2021.

In a statement to the Aadland campaign, Allen said:
"I am pleased to endorse Erik Aadland for Congress in the 7th Congressional District. As a law enforcement official with 17 years of experience I value Erik's strong commitment to public safety, and his demonstrated passion to uphold and defend our Constitutionally protected rights. Erik knows and appreciates the foundational role that public safety plays in the flourishing of our community. Erik will face the crises we are facing in Colorado and our nation and he will be a champion for law and order. Erik has served our nation and has the resolve necessary to fight on our behalf in Washington, and restore the promise embodied by 'We The People'. I have every confidence that, just as he was in the military and the private sector, Erik will be a strong servant leader who keeps the concerns of his constituents foremost in his thoughts and actions."
|
---
|
---
|
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I'm truly appreciative of the confidence that District Attorney Allen has placed in me with his endorsement. We have a mutual concern with the chaos facing our community due to the political bullying that has degraded the capabilities of our brave law enforcement professionals. As a Congressman, I will be proud to carry forth the mandate given me by our voters to restore confidence in these key institutions
---
---
| |
---
|
---
| | [Send Erik your feedback](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001bWHLQrqrgKpAvTjn8DeV-daLcZgqH6PtGjs4WfHHY23wuJLlaRhEbBNvghCvFN1ZgvM1E-UJGRywaFbHWTa8-MEjJyvLGh2PRcywRxwSDqEf9lI_nfRLCNejvY7I1dwr_I0xhsU9G05juMG5jgsZEpwGD8RwAiYwhHLOS5Sdh6xXz1vjUukK_qaHfLq7O5e4k71WXKX1w2-LRw-2_Sj-UMhYPPSkZXIba2y1BQdgbRuLH9SrI1JPP9FESsexCtJiFaZvl9_VqA0=&c=Sl89B_VFalpt-XDo5ek4E1rIsRsQzMPvdn_aYZVA8Fs4qTeNZTd4Vg==&ch=Hd1HnHPTO0xNjagN5UxhWAswUBttiIH6Md9LP8W44fv266_NGoblDQ==)
---
| |
---
|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

clean_body: Law & Justice backs Erik for Congress | | | | | | Park County Sheriff & Colorado District Attorney | | (June 17, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Sheriff Tom McGraw and District Attorney Michael Allen. | | | ---|--- | Sheriff McGraw has a vast law enforcement background spanning 35 years. Beginning as a reserve deputy, he joined the force fulltime at the age of 19. McGraw spent nine years as a patrol deputy, advancing to Corporal within five years and Detective within eight, McGraw's resume includes two years in fraud, five years in homicide, three years in public corruption, and a total of 16 years in narcotics, assisting rural agencies with narcotics, homicide and fraud investigations. McGraw retired at the rank of Inspector, with thousands of hours in training and experience working in conjunction with various law enforcement agencies across the state of Florida. McGraw is a certified firearms and defensive tactics instructor, and prior SWAT team leader. In his statement, Sheriff McGraw said: "Erik Aadland is a man of proven character. That's why it's my pleasure to endorse him as the best candidate for Congress in Colorado's 7th district. As an elected sheriff and career law enforcement professional, I know what it means to lead teams with discernment and precision. Erik is a leader of the same caliber. The depth and significance of his experience, both in the military and in the energy sector, speak well for his ability to find solutions and build coalitions to effect positive change in Washington. Please join with me in supporting Erik Aadland as our next Congressman. He is ready to stand for our community." | Erik's Remarks | | | | "I am deeply grateful to Sheriff McGraw for his kind endorsement. We agree that stakes are high in today's political climate, and that Coloradans deserve a candidate who knows what it means to defend our Constitution under the most critical of circumstances. Just as I risked my life on the battlefield for our country, I am prepared to do whatever it takes to unfailingly protect our rights and to advocate for our freedoms." | | | | ---|--- | Michael Allen is the 4th Judicial District Attorney. Allen enlisted into the Navy after graduating from Arvada West High School then served as an Aviation Electronics Technician--most recently aboard the USS Carl Vinson--until receiving an Honorable Discharge in 1998. Allen earned his undergraduate degree from the University of Northern Colorado and a law degree from the University of Kansas. Allen began his legal career as a prosecutor intern in the Johnson County Kansas District Attorney's Office, Kansas Attorney General's Office, and the Douglas County KS District Attorney's Office. He joined the 4th Judicial District Attorney's Office (serving Teller and El Paso Counties) in 2011 and has served the Pikes Peak region in several roles. Allen was sworn in as the elected District Attorney of Colorado's Fourth Judicial District on January 12, 2021. In a statement to the Aadland campaign, Allen said: "I am pleased to endorse Erik Aadland for Congress in the 7th Congressional District. As a law enforcement official with 17 years of experience I value Erik's strong commitment to public safety, and his demonstrated passion to uphold and defend our Constitutionally protected rights. Erik knows and appreciates the foundational role that public safety plays in the flourishing of our community. Erik will face the crises we are facing in Colorado and our nation and he will be a champion for law and order. Erik has served our nation and has the resolve necessary to fight on our behalf in Washington, and restore the promise embodied by 'We The People'. I have every confidence that, just as he was in the military and the private sector, Erik will be a strong servant leader who keeps the concerns of his constituents foremost in his thoughts and actions." | | | | Erik's Remarks | | | | "I'm truly appreciative of the confidence that District Attorney Allen has placed in me with his endorsement. We have a mutual concern with the chaos facing our community due to the political bullying that has degraded the capabilities of our brave law enforcement professionals. As a Congressman, I will be proud to carry forth the mandate given me by our voters to restore confidence in these key institutions | | | | | == | | | About Erik | | | Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children. | | About Aadland For Congress | | | Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors. You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. subject: Your invitation to learn
body:
The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmvbuar4cb13seisvebadn9nblgs17k3tv7qdnug_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uaqbfcrgm5hj8srn65j77d5gclh3dd77mdrm4oj66gqbdcjjeep30splcliecs77q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shmcoq69cr0curm6phgm2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5cdg68o30spi649fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zas5r3hbab289cls0f786qkmbefogpckqd0412bo_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i60o76chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, The events of the last year have no precedent in our nation’s history. They’ve shaken me, and I’m sure they’ve affected you as well. Throughout it all, you may have noticed a recurring theme from the progressives in the media, Big Tech, and politics. They insist that the government designed by our Founding Fathers, as expressed in the Constitution, is **flawed** and **outdated** —not adequate for the challenges of our time. How should defenders of the Constitution, like you and me, respond to such charges? Well, a few early champions of the Constitution—Alexander Hamilton, John Jay, and James Madison—have given you the guide: _The Federalist Papers_. Written between October 1787 and August 1788 under the pen name Publius, _The Federalist Papers_ were originally published as newspaper editorials intended to explain the merits of the Constitution. Thomas Jefferson described _The Federalist Papers_ as “the best commentary on the principles of government which ever was written.” That means that defenders of the Constitution have no better help in understanding the principles of liberty underlying our Constitution than the words of the Founders themselves. **So, I’d like to send you our entire 10-lesson course, “ _The Federalist Papers_ ,”on DVD today with a donation of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.** _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ course comes in a beautiful DVD box set for viewing in your home or a small group. You might also find it useful for a homeschool curriculum or personal study. It’s taught by Hillsdale’s knowledgeable faculty and will deepen your understanding of this incredibly relevant document even more. The DVD can also make an excellent gift for a friend or family member unfamiliar with our nation’s founding principles of liberty. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zilbl7qnnlvi6t37760da5p3nj73fsq7r352llug_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i60o76chh2bs) Supplies are limited, though, so get this special edition of **_“The Federalist Papers”_** on DVD today. Given that more than 200,000 people have taken this course already, you can bet the DVD box set won’t last long. Click here to learn more about this DVD and order your copy of _**“The Federalist Papers”**_ today: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-federalist-papers**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zmsvg24cdl19n54b0jh476h5mafmpjpmrvoa84i8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i60o76chh2bs) Warm regards, Bill Gray Class of 2001 Associate Vice President of National Donor Outreach Hillsdale College

| Peter,
Want to know why proven leader Sheriff Joe Lombardo was able to CRUSH last week's Nevada Republican Primary for Governor?
We'll give you the inside scoop:

name: Tom Schatz, Citizens Against Government Waste
subject: Would you like to pay off someone else’s loans?
body:
Joe Biden and his handlers are running our economy straight into the ground and they have no plans to stop it from getting worse
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv9da7597f803ntrsctjelchdfuvf81vq7bim2p8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i60o72cph238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf2cdkeuqj2oplmoomcobnm5h3ec9jcmrbed5me4oe8t72mjimed34m5jj4sr5esrt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor1ddgc1r60phmc2pmcdtgmlin49fg)
Joe Biden and his handlers are running our economy straight into the ground and they have no plans to stop it from getting worse. With gas and groceries the most expensive they've been in decades, and many American families barely getting by, Joe Biden's plan is to waste even more of your money on progressive pet projects. **He wants to use your hard-earned money to forgive student loans – in other words, he wants to make you pay for loans you never took out.** And make no mistake: these Leftists know exactly what's going to happen if they pass this preposterous plan. They know it's only going to make your grocery and gas bills even higher. But they don't care. If they get their way, this will be yet another tax on families like yours. If you ask me, it’s a solution worse than the problem. But I want to hear from you. ** ** [**Please take Citizens Against Government Waste’s brief Student Debt Relief Survey, and let us know where you stand.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsrdi04s4atlfb9qjri0maim4n8bcai6613vqclg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i60o72cph2bs) [Click To Take The Survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9rcjfdmnmtv9jo2k1ffpnln0pm61ssmaiqu31do_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i60o72cph2bs) Now, I don’t know if you’ve heard of Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) before – but it’s one of the few forces in Washington working FOR you and not against you, and I’ll tell you how. My name is Tom Schatz, and I’m the president of CAGW. We aren’t just against government waste in name ... we oppose and DEFEAT government waste in action. **For every $1 donated, we’ve eliminated $9,000 in destructive spending.** In 1984, President Reagan said that CAGW is “vital in the battle against budget deficits” and “the impact of your work is incalculable,” and we have worked hard every day to live up to his inspiring words. _Our success is thanks to patriots like you._ But we don’t just depend on your generosity – we depend on your feedback.
[**That’s why I hope you’ll take this Student Debt Relief Survey right away,**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuko66gupplhlfq8386kaur9e3cs88ia0vi8g38o_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i60o72cph2bs)**and give us the insight we need to best serve the American people.** We know America can’t afford policies based on what sounds nice or what feels good – because that’s what got us in the mess we’re in now. We need policies that work for everyone. Because while politicians in Washington treat you like a piggy bank with a pulse, and try to fleece you for everything you have, CAGW is, as President Reagan said, a group “whose only loyalty is ... to the taxpayer.” Thank you in advance for your feedback. ** ** Sincerely, Tom Schatz President Citizens Against Government Waste [Click To Take The Survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhaaeo0ajpu3dd9qsirlq75j7dk14n5ef7fro020_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i60o72cph2bs) | |

Dear Peter,

The destructive Montana floods which have taken out bridges and left folks stranded, homeless, businesses closed, and agriculture in jeopardy point to a serious problem. According to the [American Road and Transportation Builders Association](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00130Wb-_nH3aXMq46B_xC71wdyc6zXfzt0qRvfZLMr_TPXF8gPdZOnS7xDVwaaOSIQpaITZ-zO1ba1b2HR6eW2WadgAHHfUiyPnuwHwiY1szzDjmax8IFJ8mzIEhCT5Y7IkpC-26YNk_O2gXmVm9MyWWahaer5Fa8IvRZZgRWMTdj131bbMZJskA==&c=5tHDSQ3aMjIACcvU-13RJGkATVpaJKQ_k_wJGoKOAuDP3yPs5D2vJw==&ch=Pz_l9FfvNbBmSfzYs42n2ThOesVQajbeQ6j4x-1pRFGYq0NYoEX26Q==), Montana "has identified needed repairs on 971 bridges at an estimated cost of $709.2 million."

So it's a good thing, as [Vote Smart](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00130Wb-_nH3aXMq46B_xC71wdyc6zXfzt0qRvfZLMr_TPXF8gPdZOnS7xDVwaaOSIQ8TFFUIV07QulUxU8MqE2BzL_Ber1ij-MTUx_Ipy6oViE_E0wqe_wR5Ikok1Nx-lN7cSd9QTtD6XcSrQr-mQ7Zv-ioecopvv1WkTT29RqZv3ZPnA8WVTGvxCItUmh7jP0SOrjuwsaXfr_0qnIYql5Nb8SpXRGWMoaj1bDDSfu3hz_n3vp3yW_HK9ApEKhFPV0&c=5tHDSQ3aMjIACcvU-13RJGkATVpaJKQ_k_wJGoKOAuDP3yPs5D2vJw==&ch=Pz_l9FfvNbBmSfzYs42n2ThOesVQajbeQ6j4x-1pRFGYq0NYoEX26Q==) reports, that the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act "establishes the Rebuild Rural Bridges Program and appropriates $250 million each beginning 2023 and each year through fiscal year 2026 to improve the safety and state of good repair of bridges in rural communities."

You'd think a representative who cared about rural Montana, and the safety of Montanans in general, would have voted YES on the infrastructure bill. A bill that invests in Montana through improved safety measures, high paying jobs, addressing climate change, broadband expansion, and more. But Matt Rosendale voted NO. Matt Rosendale has voted NO on 94 out of 98 votes since he has been in Congress. Montana needs better. Let's start getting things done for Montana.

Representation matters. It's time to send a Representative to Congress with a proven track record of working FOR Montanans. Please donate what you can today to help send Penny to Washington, D.C. Montana deserves her!

| | Hey team, I’ll make this quick. I’m checking in to ask a simple question – **are you still with us?** I know, it might seem silly to ask that when you already know how high the stakes of this race are. But, since Susie won her primary and is now facing far-right April Becker, **we’ve been surprised to see a lower rate of support than we anticipated.** Look, as Campaign Manager, I can confidently say that the post-primary months are the most crucial part of a campaign. It’s what will determine how this campaign will fare leading up to November and if we can start off strong in the coming weeks. name: Lizzie Pannill Fletcher
subject: What we now know about January 6
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220623?refcode=lpfe220623 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220623?refcode=lpfe220623]
Dear friend,
This week’s House Committee to Investigate the January 6 Attack on the United States Capitol hearings had me in tears. And I know I am not the only one.
Since the attack, I have shared with many my own personal experience on January 6, 2021. It is important for me to do, of course, because I am an eyewitness to the attack, an attack some of my House colleagues have now sought to minimize as a “tourist visit” and others have belittled as a “dustup.”
January 6 was an attack on the Capitol. But it was much more. It was an attack on America. It was an attack on Americans. And it was an attack on democracy itself. And this week’s hearings have brought that home.
It is so important to know what January 6 and all that surrounded it meant for people across the country, from elected leaders to election administrators. This week, we heard from them. I can’t imagine there was a dry eye in the hearing room as Shaye Moss testified about her love for helping people exercise their right to vote, about her grandmother’s lessons about the importance of voting, or about what President Trump and his supporters did to her and her mother in 2020. If you missed it, go watch it. It is as moving, as heartbreaking, as terrifying, and as infuriating as it gets.
We saw in her what our country is supposed to be. And we saw in her story a warning of what it could be if we do not do everything we can to protect our elections and our democracy – starting with the people who make it possible in every precinct and every polling place in the country.
We are learning so much about the sinister plot to overthrow the election, and the many ways it was carried out. The lies. The pressure campaign. The violence. And the promise of more.
I am so grateful to my House colleagues for their diligent work and their commitment to the truth. Each of us has work to do, too. Watching the hearings, educating ourselves, and sharing what we learn with others is an important start. Committing ourselves to vote for people who are on the side of democracy – from county clerks to secretaries of state to legislators – and getting other voters to the polls who will do so, too, is critical.
It is not an exaggeration to say that this year’s election is essential to protecting democracy itself. That’s why I am so grateful for all the people who have been working together on this team to do this since 2018, and you are why I believe we can do it.
Together, we can do anything,

clean_body: = Hey team, I want to make sure you saw this: We launched our campaign’s first TV ad of the NY-10 Democratic Primary! = The new ad is now airing across New York’s 10th Congressional District, and I’m proud to share my story of overcoming adversity to become a progressive champion in Congress. The script reads: “Do I stand out in Washington? Yes. Let’s see, I’m a New Yorker. I grew up in Section 8 housing and on food stamps, raised by a single mom. I’m Black, I’m gay, and damn proud to be different. As a member of Congress, I’ve fought to bring real change to a broken system. To make Washington work for us — not them.” But I’ll be blunt, team. Keeping our new TV ad on air costs money. A lot of money. As we head into these final weeks before the August 23rd primary election, it’s more important than ever that we have the resources to spread the word about our grassroots campaign. subject: Socialists are coming to elementary schools
body:
| | | Hello, When I was growing up, parents worried about college indoctrinating their kids into radical socialists. Now, the indoctrination is starting even earlier. Here are some recent examples that shocked me.
---
* Teachers are being forced to accept that math is a form of white supremacy.
* The National Education Association is calling on Biden to stop vouchers to private schools and no new charter schools. The goal seems to be to put all education under government control.
* Our public schools are being taken over by social justice advocates who believe everything is political, including grade school education.

---
All is not lost! I believe we have to take our education into our own hands. And I think I have found a solution. **I want to introduce you to Connor Boyack. He is the author of the Tuttle Twins.** The Tuttle Twins is a book series, teaching children about free markets, private property rights, and the ideas of our Founding Fathers.

[**Can you support teaching younger generations about the ideas of liberty? Please click here to donate to the Tuttle Twins >>**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63845%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Evi%2bz5DONTCTR4xZ9kw9FQ&sysid=1) Connor created the series when he realized there were no children’s books teaching these important topics. Connor’s organization, Libertas Institute, is on a mission to distribute 1,000,000 copies of the Tuttle twins into the hands of homeschooled children, public schools, and libraries across the country during 2021.
---
---
_2 million copies of the Tuttle Twins have been distributed to families and children across the country. _
---
The Tuttle Twins are a solution for parents or community members who are worried about the future of education. I told Connor I would help him raise $50,000 to distribute 5,000 copies of the Tuttle Twins. Here is how you can help Connor and Libertas Institute. [**Will you join me and donate $10, $25, $50, $100, or more to Libertas Institute and help us fight back against the socialists’ indoctrination in our schools? Click here to donate >>**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63846%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DO7lNaiH8t6ChlKg1HTIyg&sysid=1) **One more important point ... All online donations are being matched by one of the Libertas Institute’s biggest supporters, John P. You can double your impact! If you donate $100, John will personally match it with another $100 gift.*** Here’s how your support goes into distributing thousands of copies of the Tuttle Twins.
---
1. Libertas Institute is working with like-minded teachers and librarians to place books in school classrooms across the country.

| | |
---
Hi, Peter, do you have a minute? These last few months since launching my campaign have been a complete whirlwind.
I've been hard at work meeting voters, building a grassroots coalition, crisscrossing our state, and introducing myself to supporters like you.**I've heard so many stories from voters here – about their struggles, their joys, and their hopes for our future. **
People here in Missouri know that Washington is broken. We see it firsthand as affordable, quality healthcare is nearly impossible to find, as the opioid epidemic continues to throw our families into crisis, as prices soar and wages remain the same – as it gets harder and harder for families to achieve their American Dream. Our government has the power to change all of that, but our leaders refuse to act.
Washington needs more compassionate, honest leaders who will put in the work to make life better for our communities. That's why I'm running for Senate – and I am so, so grateful to have you on my team.

Peter, I’ve heard “you can’t” too many times to count. I heard it when my wife Meghann and I were organizing for marriage equality across the South. I heard it when I ran for County Commissioner.
But here’s what I know for sure.
You show what’s possible by getting out there and doing the work. That’s how we won marriage equality in the South. And it’s how I’ve been elected, _twice_ so far.
**That’s why I am out with our incredible team organizing in every corner of the district, meeting voters exactly where they are, listening to what matters to them, and building from that foundation.**

We need leaders who know what it’s like to be written off simply because of who you are and who know we are at our best as a country when we instead build tables where there is room for everyone.
The power of our grassroots team has shown that we have a path to defeating Chuck Edwards and flipping NC-11 blue. And with our FEC deadline coming up at the end of the month, we have to show everyone doubting us that we have the strength to win.

Friend, moments ago, the Supreme Court officially sided with the gun lobby and handed down a decision that will drastically increase the number of concealed weapons in a staggering blow to public safety. **Tens or even hundreds of thousands more people can now legally carry concealed weapons in public places.**
**Above all else, I’m frustrated.** In the wake of multiple mass shootings over the last few weeks – and more than 250 this year alone – this decision is absolutely ABSURD.
Friend, the truth is that gun violence isn't inevitable: It's a policy choice made by public officials like Marco Rubio, who is too beholden to the gun lobby to do what's right by Floridians and the rest of the country.
Throughout his career, Rubio has collected more than $3.3 MILLION in exchange for doing the gun lobby’s bidding – and frankly, it’s disgusting. But it doesn't have to be this way; we can pass legislation to save lives from gun violence.
The gun violence epidemic kills thousands of Americans and Floridians every _year_ , and it’s time we finally have a majority fighting for their safety in the Senate. **That’s why I vow to never cower from or cater to the whims of the gun lobby and to instead be a fighter for gun safety reform – but I can’t continue my fight without your help.**

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: Sad but true
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Alexandria was named and threatened directly in a new video released by the January 6 committee.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220623-3130-header&t=1&akid=3130%2E2526796%2EKyey9r)
_Warning: This email contains descriptions of violence and strong language._
Last week, Alexandria was named and threatened directly in a new video released by the January 6 committee.
In the video, an insurrectionist (who received a tour of the Capitol by Rep. Loudermilk on January 5) said during the attack:_“There’s no escape [...] We’re coming for you. We’re coming in like white on rice for Pelosi, Nadler, Schumer, even you AOC. We’re coming to take you out and pull you out by your hair.” 1_
**A reporter asked Alexandria her response. Here’s what she had to say:**
_“I think it's been very clear for a very long time that I work with people who wish me harm ... who wish me physical harm, who wish me political harm, who wish me harm – and it’s not just Representative Loudermilk._
_You have many members of Congress who have specifically used my name to incite violence and this has been happening well before the 6th. Many people experience the 6th in very different ways. I experienced it as a culmination of the violent rhetoric, not a first-time or a one-time spike.”_
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220623.jkkh_p&refcode=em20220623-3130-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3130%2E2526796%2EKyey9r)
It’s sad, but true. These attacks are not new.
Last year, Representative Paul Gosar – a Republican from Arizona – tweeted an animated video depicting him killing Alexandria.2 The House passed a resolution to censure Rep. Gosar for his actions, but his Republican colleagues defended him.
Representative Ted Yoho called Alexandria “a f— b—” on the steps of the Capitol, meanwhile Representative Marjory Taylor Greene chased after Alexandria screaming and stalked her office with fellow insurrectionists.3 These attacks are not new, but they’re equally alarming.
[Alexandria is a target because our opponents know how powerful our movement is. Can you help us continue to support Alexandria’s work in Congress by chipping in $3 or whatever you can today?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220623.jkkh_p&refcode=em20220623-3130-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3130%2E2526796%2EKyey9r)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220623.jkkh_p&refcode=em20220623-3130-P_FND_ANO_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3130%2E2526796%2EKyey9r)**
Through all of this, Alexandria is laser focused on doing her job and fighting for _all of us_ in Congress. It’s not easy, but we can help make it easier by making sure she has the grassroots support required to fend off these attacks and win her reelection in November.
Thank you for all your support. It means the world.
Team AOC
1 - [January 6 Committee

name: American Defense News
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z62hllrer62io7hsrmmmpreio6feu9avbu5f76t0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbon3dpkmppndchnm9hj2t3he5jmcsjgccojfdln68pjdcbmedob8pb26iobasr76v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666obbc30epi6cdb2mdh6fc5lclp238h1e8he4933clhm0p31c5j62oh5u)
This sponsored message from American Defense News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zh6f65i4un99ebjugcsfkp692tuk8ep1v01ejm9g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i62ob6c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zj6q2oni0p0mr89ar9368f9sjv6b5f60paccq970_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i62ob6c5h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zr0f82ihq701lgbrvltkjiat7j4ofr2rltv9on2g_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i62ob6c5h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

subject: Elissa’s opponent just voted against MORE jobs
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress

Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220623-2&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220623-2&amount=28]
Team,
We wanted to follow up on the email we sent this morning on the contrast between Elissa and her opponent with even MORE news.
Elissa’s opponent just voted against a bipartisan majority in the Michigan Senate appropriations committee that is bringing another 3,200 good-paying auto jobs to Michigan through new Ford plants in Dearborn, Wayne, and Flat Rock. This comes after he voted against support for the new GM electric vehicle battery plant in his own district, in Delta Township... bringing the total number of Michigan auto jobs he’s voted against up to 8,200.
He has to jump through hoops to explain his votes -- because he knows voting against good jobs in his own community just doesn’t make sense. While he may have started out as a reasonable person, he has crept further and further from the moderate middle. Today’s deal was deeply bipartisan – and he stands proudly outside of that consensus.
So we thought it was a good moment to highlight some differences. Please chip in today to send a message to Elissa’s opponent: you can’t keep putting ideology and special interests over your own constituents. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220623-2&amount=28]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220623-2&amount=28]
Team Slotkin
Team,
Elissa has always been a firm believer that actions speak louder than words.
During her first election, she pledged to never accept a dime of corporate PAC money, because she never wants her constituents to question whether their interests are her priority in Congress. Her campaign is funded by grassroots supporters chipping in what they can, when they can. And when they do, it’s not because they are getting bombarded with fake deadlines or “sky-is-falling” rhetoric. (Trust us – she writes or edits every single email we put out – including this one!)
Her opponent’s actions and votes also speak volumes: he voted against the deal that paved the way for a $7 billion investment from GM that is creating a new electric vehicle battery plant in Lansing, and 5,000 jobs in mid-Michigan.
He also heavily benefits from being a consistent supporter of DeVos family policies – like their recent petition drive aimed at giving tax breaks to donors who fund school vouchers. On top of that, he's voted against every single Michigan education budget since he took elected office 7 years ago.
As a result, the DeVos family has already helped him secure two big swanky fundraisers this year, one featuring Mike Pence. Not long after supporting their petition drive, he got $50,000 in one day from the family.
And, he’s resorted to a number of extreme fundraising methods, including using scare tactics about our children’s well-being. This spring, he approved and sent out a fundraising text where he solicited contributions as a means of canceling “your child’s gender reassignment surgery.”
The road to keeping the House runs right through Elissa’s new district, and it’s going to be her toughest election yet. But, in the most competitive House race in Michigan, the contrast couldn’t be clearer. Our end-of-quarter deadline is coming up on June 30th. Chip in below to show Elissa’s opponent that his actions speak for themselves. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq22022?refcode=email20220623-2&amount=28]

body:
We have to raise everything we can so we’re prepared to fight back.
#

Friends —
We talk a lot about FEC fundraising deadlines, so we wanted to take a moment to explain why they are so important to Mark Kelly’s chances.
When an FEC deadline ends, candidates are legally required to report how much money they’ve raised. Right now, our opponents don’t know what we’ve raised. And we don’t know what they’ve raised either.
There could be campaigns, PACs, or dark money groups raising absurd amounts of money, and they’re ready to spring it on us. That could mean attacks ads on TV, on the radio, online, billboards — even blimps. Seriously. We won’t know for sure until after this deadline.
We have to raise everything we can so we’re prepared to fight back, no matter what happens.
At the same time, outside groups will be looking to see what we’ve raised. They’ll want to know if we’re vulnerable. If we are, they’re more likely to attack. But if we file a strong report, we might be able to scare them off.
That’s why these deadlines are so important — strategically and practically. We look at all these reports and make important budget decisions.
And since these emails are the primary way Mark Kelly’s campaign raises money, it means we have to ask:

subject: Please help these young conservatives
body:
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7snfh47b2b1upqenoi2gep8iun6f7hv1dme7ns8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i66oj2c9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65sj2m9h70oljm1oj6t9gm5qj2plhm1o68cr0eaojat36m9hmct9n6lin8p5ic6rrfkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj33c5lm1g7cpj66jgb6ob7m2qmash5u)
I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg9dpe8nsl7u27i0kdv35cos2ufu8ipnlbev8qo0_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i66oj2c9h2bs) Fellow Conservative, I have an urgent request on behalf of 50 young conservatives. Please help them. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training programs is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. **My staff just sent me an urgent email to let me know the demand to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zp6t085kcd1i7j5o3f45lj21kppt32crsducqjpg_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i66oj2c9h2bs) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpv8sf6mvki6niit9f3ctomq3s2cot485st5etc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb3c1i66oj2c9h2bs) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute

---

Friend -- The Democrats are holding their 2022 State Convention in La Crosse this weekend...but try as they might to ignore their failed record that has led to sky-high inflation, a crippled supply chain, and rising crime across the state, we’re holding them accountable. name: Giffords
subject: Terrible SCOTUS “Guns Everywhere” ruling this morning
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
This is a disastrous decision that will only lead to more guns in more places
#

Friends -
Earlier today, a conservative supermajority on the Supreme Court overturned a century-old New York State law requiring people to have a permit for people to carry concealed firearms in public places like Times Square.
This is a disastrous decision that will only lead to more guns in more places, which will lead to more gun violence and more preventable death.
That is what the evidence shows, and that is what the Supreme Court ignored today.
This decision reminds us that even as the Senate is poised to pass the first major gun safety bill in almost three decades, we still have a long way to go.
There’s more on this ruling below, but it’s important we ask you to make a contribution to Giffords PAC today to help us continue to fight to make our communities safer from gun violence.
[**Please use this link to contribute $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Giffords PAC today. It all adds up when we’re all chipping in.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june22.JkdLIw&refcode=em220623-1-15&t=1&akid=2165%2E3935704%2Eo9abcX)
Alright...
There are two competing visions at play in this case.
Ours is that the courts have long ruled over and over that commonsense gun safety measures do not infringe on the Second Amendment.
The NRA’s vision is more guns in more places, without regard to how many people want to protect their communities from gun violence, without regard to how many people die as a result of their extreme policies.
Today’s decisions removed the rights of states to regulate guns in public places. But more than that, it also puts at risk laws in dozens of states that require some form of licensing for carrying concealed weapons.
It is an extreme ruling that thwarts not just the will of the people, but their elected representatives and scientific research demonstrating the danger of guns in our public spaces.
Sadly, the gun lobby has found a sympathetic ear in the new, superconservative Supreme Court.
Like we said, we have a long way to go in the fight to make our communities safer from gun violence. That was always going to be the case.
We will not stop fighting, because lives are on the line, but Gabby cannot do it alone:

Peter,

Our democracy is at a crossroads. Our Supreme Court is intent on rolling back our civil rights, Congress has failed so far to protect our communities from gun violence – meanwhile Illinois families are struggling to afford gas and groceries.

**Your vote has never mattered more.** That’s why I’m urging you to make a plan to vote in the June 28 primary **and** to help your friends and families do the same!

This is what I want you to think about:

**How are you casting your vote?**
Illinois voters have the option of [requesting a mail ballot](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46881915/352161570/1628797685?source=JJ_EM_GOTV_WL_220623_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Yzc1NWFmMi0zNGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YrIBc6HLPamfJySF252g6DnszMzVfidyPqwp5G_Yb28=&emci=2efa2d7d-33f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=8c755af2-34f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239) for any reason, but the deadline to do so is today. You can also vote early in-person at any of the early voting locations listed below, or find your polling place for Election Day on June 28.
* [Early Voting Locations - City of Chicago](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46881917/352161571/-513614019?source=JJ_EM_GOTV_WL_220623_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Yzc1NWFmMi0zNGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YrIBc6HLPamfJySF252g6DnszMzVfidyPqwp5G_Yb28=&emci=2efa2d7d-33f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=8c755af2-34f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=9019239)

**When will you vote?**
* If you are voting by mail, your ballot must be postmarked no later than June 28 and arrive at the election office within 14 days afterward.
* If you are voting early in-person, please check the hours of operation at your specific location as they vary from location to location.
* Polls will be open on Election Day from 6 a.m. to 7 p.m.

**How will you get to your polling place?**
Will you walk, drive, or take public transportation? Be sure to leave enough time for your chosen mode of transportation!

**Who will you vote for?**
_I’m counting on your vote for Congress in IL-01_ but be sure to look at the other offices up for election in this primary and know ahead of time who will best champion working families in our communities!

**Who will you bring with you?**
This is one of the most important parts of your plan to vote, Peter. We’re in a competitive Democratic primary and I need every vote possible in order to bring our fight to Congress. **That’s why I’m asking you to forward this email to three people you can bring with you to vote.** Same-day registration is available at all polling locations, including early voting locations, so please be sure to help the teens, elderly, and other disenfranchised people in your life so they can make their voices heard.

Thank you for doing your part in our democracy,

Jonathan | **[CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46881922/352161579/1912246793?amount=10&source=JJ_EM_GOTV_WL_220623_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTgzOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Yzc1NWFmMi0zNGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YrIBc6HLPamfJySF252g6DnszMzVfidyPqwp5G_Yb28=)**

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

In the past weeks, Congress has been holding hearings to reveal findings
from their investigation of what happened on January 6. We’ve learned more
details about the lead up to the U.S. Capitol insurrection and who is
responsible for this act of white supremacy.

It’s more evident than ever that Trump and his allies like Rand Paul are
responsible for the violence and carnage of January 6. It was fueled by
hate and racism, lies of a “stolen” election, and a desperate grab for
power. Countless first responders were critically injured. Six people
died.

We refuse to forget the sacrifice of our first responders. We refuse to
forget this attack on our democracy. We must continue calling for justice
until every person, every elected official involved in the attack is held
accountable.

You know who wishes we’d forget? Rand Paul. He’s tried countless times to
gaslight us into thinking it was just a “tourist visit”. Rand voted to
block a full investigation into what happened.

Because he was complicit. For months leading up to the attack, Rand Paul
stoked his base, promoting false narratives of “stolen votes” and fraud —
a claim that members of his own party have even walked back.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220623.8sh1RY&refcode=em20220623-2110&t=1001&akid=2110%2E346206%2EB5BOUy ][IMG]

It’s shameful — but it is nothing new,
Peter. For years, Rand Paul has
been working to suppress our votes to keep his own seat.

Kentucky has one of the worst records of voter disenfranchisement in our
country’s history. For too long, massive groups of people, especially
Black and brown communities, have been excluded and discouraged from
voting. As a result, the number of people in Kentucky who don’t vote
outnumber those who do.

We know that a different type of politics is possible — and that’s what
our movement is fighting for. Together, we have the power to replace Rand
Paul and every politician who betrayed our democracy last January.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220623.8sh1RY&refcode=em20220623-2110&t=1002&akid=2110%2E346206%2EB5BOUy ]If you’re ready to join me in this work, will you chip in
$5 or anything you can today to our people-powered
campaign? We must send a loud and clear message today to Rand Paul that
this movement remembers and that we are rising up to hold him accountable
at the ballot box on Election Day.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220623.8sh1RY&refcode=em20220623-2110&t=1021&akid=2110%2E346206%2EB5BOUy ]Contribute $5

Together we can save our Democracy,

Charles Booker

## The Greater Metro Denver Ministerial Alliance Endorses the Neal Walia Campaign!
---
| | We are excited to share that the Greater Denver Ministerial Alliance has endorsed our campaign. We are humbled by this community support and belief in our vision and platform. Together with community we believe we can truly make a change in Congressional District One and across the Nation.

"The Greater Metro Denver Ministerial Alliance being an 82-year old organization has had the opportunity to view and experience many things in the community. Being that The Alliance is majority African American its important that who represents us shows up! It’s important that our representative is for all the people! We believe Neal Walia has the right vision and platform that represents change in our community and he brings new ideas as we deal with a plethora of new situations in our community. It is with great pleasure that The Greater Metro Denver Ministerial Alliance endorses Neal Walia."
---
| | | |
---|---|---
| | We are just a few days away from election day and _**we need your help**_ to win this race! We are phone banking everyday to help make plans with supporters on how to get their ballots in! We need your help to reach as many CD-1 residents in the coming days. If you have not signed up already please email _**info@nealwaliaforcongress.com**_ and let us know you'd like to get set up to make calls!

name: Phil Wood
subject: Pray.Free. Vote.Free. Eat.Free.
body:
Hi Everyone,

Please encourage everyone you know to *vote next Tuesday!* What a great
privilege we have and I hope many take advantage of the opportunity.

On behalf of our nation and our world, Javier Comboni is leading a *prayer
gathering* in Carol Stream on *Sunday evening at 7 pm.* You are invited.

On *Monday *there is a *rally for Darren Bailey* in DesPlaines. After that,
he will head down to Effingham where his campaign began. Please attend if
you are available.

Also, on the night of the election, *next Tuesday*, Penne and I will
be at *Chrissy's
Bar & Grill *on Gary Avenue in Carol Stream for several hours in the
evening beginning around 5 pm. We would love to thank everyone personally
for your prayers, encouragement, and effort during the past 6 months.

[image: image.png]

The Left’s aim is two-fold:
* Divide and weaken the Right
* Distract from the disaster that is the Biden-Harris administration

That's why you and I must call the Left out, support strong Republican candidates, and continue to talk about why conservative policies improve the lives of Americans and beat liberal schemes... every single time. This is a political effort, and the only way to stop the Left is to vote liberals out at the ballot box in this year's midterm elections. We have less than 5 months left until November. [**Every day, the Democrats grow their war chest of funds, prepare new attacks against Republicans, and fight to protect their razor-thin majority at all costs.**](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=a6c79eecc2d547d3b6c0812d6bf99aae&_e=qKjQBApp5fc92EWnJPnlss3Nbq_f6C-_wZ9trVHLEhO9LIb7kKKBpcXTlPJnNnyp0zRau75k2WoNG2xBfHvqK07Izd__2swq1datJ7ldvTDBvj7EZci6kzTq_rVdatQJQxkhL0aVo_h8xHWt1oK2m5td98xgzRCT81I4txYBVcs6aSqbrUxUfjhDQQ_POc8pukBc_cxZ7q9xN3EJiqhDysvsuOY1mSKg3aSef-yBfV5MEn65BWsCaYFT-OZbGaqMGfTwNKHzxnjjwKz5uXdXB6R-gqbHZ0995ZhNK1YuIsHSQ4vw8M8ZWO-Of0ei0OTxKjrXpBRTNJgobd4J6ibmTvNcHSIg4T5q06l1nhHvqNhlNiXmAZTC0ZwBm7HCkJ_SUa0x6Ckvz2U1rhBPlxq1j6Q5iwHdmM-r631jdIE4E_8%3D) We both know the toll the Left has had on our country since Biden took office. Gas prices. Groceries. Rent. All of it has soared. 70% of Americans think America is on the wrong track. The Left’s failures are obvious. **But it doesn’t mean Republicans have victory in the bag.** Democrats are raking in resources to defeat Republicans in key battleground states. They’re trying to divide our party to weaken our chances of defeating them. **We must remember, there is just one goal this November:** Elect a red wave of strong, freedom-loving Republicans all across the country. That means taking back our majorities in the House and Senate — and it means electing Republicans at the state level, too.We cannot let the Democrats’ scheme work. [**That’s why I’m calling on ALL conservatives to step up and unite right now.**](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=a6c79eecc2d547d3b6c0812d6bf99aae&_e=qKjQBApp5fc92EWnJPnlss3Nbq_f6C-_wZ9trVHLEhO9LIb7kKKBpcXTlPJnNnyp0zRau75k2WoNG2xBfHvqK07Izd__2swq1datJ7ldvTDBvj7EZci6kzTq_rVdatQJQxkhL0aVo_h8xHWt1oK2m5td98xgzRCT81I4txYBVcs6aSqbrUxUfjhDQQ_POc8pukBc_cxZ7q9xN3EJiqhDyuWw3NcNxBN2zp0_SiYun2FxSRjn-1vv5EO895-fQpOSFBXOywrTBE-JET--YNbFdOXbuICk7JKMccmFSAsewYVp9KzBBsKGN-IYlAFFWPafvckDjwn6cAbu4z0eGdsxtJpYIeYvgQQTa48pE97py_0exrDCzG7eQ6m7v7C0_9DQMpqXLTxuKlxgBMNZ-lGdyGu4HaQeZCuIXALW1ZN3HMk%3D) My team has a mission to elect Republicans across the country, and it’s working. We’ve endorsed more than 40 candidates in state and federal elections. In Virginia, we rallied behind Glenn Youngkin and helped him flip the governor’s seat from BLUE to RED for the first time in 12 years. In Texas, we helped a slew of Republican candidates win their primaries. In November, we’re going to get Republicans elected to office. As you know, our mission is critical, but it’s also resource intensive. The more the Left raises to attack and defeat our candidates, the more critical it is to raise funds for these conservatives. While Democrats continue to rake in tens of millions of dollars, it can be difficult to keep up — especially in the Left’s horrific economy. **But I want you to remember what’s at stake in November and the context for the tough times we’re currently in.** The best way to bring inflation down, reduce crime, and secure our borders is to elect Republican leaders who will pass an agenda that tackles these issues straight-on. Conservatives have the solutions our country desperately needs. We need them in office to get the job done. **[So if you can give any amount whether it’s $1 or $1,000, I’m humbly asking you to pitch in with a donation today.](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=a6c79eecc2d547d3b6c0812d6bf99aae&_e=qKjQBApp5fc92EWnJPnlss3Nbq_f6C-_wZ9trVHLEhO9LIb7kKKBpcXTlPJnNnyp0zRau75k2WoNG2xBfHvqK07Izd__2swq1datJ7ldvTDBvj7EZci6kzTq_rVdatQJQxkhL0aVo_h8xHWt1oK2m5td98xgzRCT81I4txYBVcs6aSqbrUxUfjhDQQ_POc8pukBc_cxZ7q9xN3EJiqhDymIP5qZXMNR5RYuyX5kiATkoaDUxYycpNEmrn5uo7tHB0qR7hCAExN0D1fHs-7jyQsfAzgTWC4hJ2Bhr5UdMPeLttJKnaZj4pz2hh_bnbFe_7EzMCaPH4WgJ0Q-B6QxXKB9mMp98DXbUERrUiwuBqS0prH3k_Lh5o5S6vdegf7TK1gyNBQHY4oLLj2L7NXVTxwcf-Zs6PzAuscu8Ypb7IYQ%3D) ** Thank you in advance for your support.
