clean_body: | | | Friend, The Left’s aim is two-fold: Divide and weaken the Right Distract from the disaster that is the Biden-Harris administration That's why you and I must call the Left out, support strong Republican candidates, and continue to talk about why conservative policies improve the lives of Americans and beat liberal schemes... every single time. This is a political effort, and the only way to stop the Left is to vote liberals out at the ballot box in this year's midterm elections. We have less than 5 months left until November. We both know the toll the Left has had on our country since Biden took office. Gas prices. Groceries. Rent. All of it has soared. 70% of Americans think America is on the wrong track. The Left’s failures are obvious. But it doesn’t mean Republicans have victory in the bag. Democrats are raking in resources to defeat Republicans in key battleground states. They’re trying to divide our party to weaken our chances of defeating them. We must remember, there is just one goal this November: Elect a red wave of strong, freedom-loving Republicans all across the country. That means taking back our majorities in the House and Senate — and it means electing Republicans at the state level, too.We cannot let the Democrats’ scheme work. My team has a mission to elect Republicans across the country, and it’s working. We’ve endorsed more than 40 candidates in state and federal elections. In Virginia, we rallied behind Glenn Youngkin and helped him flip the governor’s seat from BLUE to RED for the first time in 12 years. In Texas, we helped a slew of Republican candidates win their primaries. In November, we’re going to get Republicans elected to office. As you know, our mission is critical, but it’s also resource intensive. The more the Left raises to attack and defeat our candidates, the more critical it is to raise funds for these conservatives. While Democrats continue to rake in tens of millions of dollars, it can be difficult to keep up — especially in the Left’s horrific economy. But I want you to remember what’s at stake in November and the context for the tough times we’re currently in. The best way to bring inflation down, reduce crime, and secure our borders is to elect Republican leaders who will pass an agenda that tackles these issues straight-on. Conservatives have the solutions our country desperately needs. We need them in office to get the job done. Thank you in advance for your support. # **South Bay CRA News**
**Monday June 27th SBRA Meeting**
Don't forget our monthly meeting this coming Monday Night! We have two exciting people speaking. We will be focusing on how we get the Hispanic vote in 2022 & 2024.

# Albert Huerta with LEXIT LA
Albert is a Pastor, Frontline Freedom Fighter, and a spokesman for LEXIT. Albert is a dynamic speaker that will bring truth to what we see today in our Nation.
|

# Elsa Aldeguer Latinos United For America
Elsa Aldeguer is a nationally known frontline activist and President and Founder of Latinos 4
Trump and Latinos United For America. In 2017. Make California Great Again, Inc.®️., appointed
Elsa Aldeguer as their Latino Coalitions Director for the United States.
Elsa’s tireless work to preserve Godly conservative values and promote President Trump’s
America First agenda in California and across the country, has earned her the “Go to Person” in
the Latino Republican community. Borned and raised in El Salvador, Elsa knows first hand the
dangers of allowing a runaway tyrannical government to take root.
Elsa continues to work with both the Latino community and the conservative community helping
Republican Congressional and Assembly candidates win their races, educating the
public, organizing rallies and protests and making sure our veterans and law enforcement are
not forgotten.
When not saving America, Elsa enjoys time with her teenage son and family, traveling, dancing,
and continues to care for neighborhood rescue cats regularly.

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Big Oil's price gouging must stop
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=86OfX7Kc1NR4Zb6u94DtSJV9gpTrhFxx&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
Try to wrap your head around this number: $35 billion - the amount of profit the top five oil companies hauled in during the first few months of this year.
Compared to the same time last year, Big Oil's profits have not merely doubled or tripled - they have _quadrupled._
**We cannot allow unfettered price gouging to line the pockets of Big Oil at the expense of everyday Americans who are hurting at the pump.**
That's why I'm joining my Democratic colleagues to take action to lower prices. This includes two key measures:
1. Imposing a windfall tax on Big Oil's ridiculous profits - a tax which would take Big Oil's excess profits and put them back into the pockets of consumers via a quarterly rebate
2. Passing a Price Gouging Prevention Act - a plan to stop companies from price gouging by imposing powerful penalties on those who implement unconscionable price hikes

But what's happening on the other side of the aisle, Friend? Absolutely nothing - save for their pathetic attempts to score political points off of skyrocketing costs and the total obstruction of good ideas to solve the problem. Republicans - who reap millions in donations from Big Oil and energy companies - are happy to let these corporations continue profiteering off of the pocketbooks of the American people.
Time and again, extremist Republicans have opposed efforts in Congress to actually _do_ something about the problem of rising gas costs. It's time to call them out for their obstruction. I created a new petition to demand that Republicans STOP blocking efforts to lower gas prices, and I'm counting on you to add your name.
**[Please, if you support our leaders taking BOLD action to bring down gas prices, will you add your name today? Overwhelming grassroots support is essential to our efforts to overcome GOP obstruction and take meaningful action, so thank you for speaking out.](https://petitions.signforgood.com/blumenthal-june-windfall?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1205-su-nd&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsurveys.signforgood.com%2Fblumenthal-june-prio-2022%3Fcode%3Djtk1205-su-nd)**
Thank you,
Dick

clean_body: he needs us as much as we need him | Friends, This might sound crazy, but I mean this with conviction: we need more hillbillies to represent us in government. America needs people in power who have seen firsthand the cost of failed leadership. We need people like my friend and Ohio Senate nominee, JD Vance. | And by hillbilly, I mean someone who has lived the struggles the American people face — and will stop at nothing to fight for a better future. JD grew up in poverty and strife. He knows how to work hard. He knows what it’s like to feel neglected, left behind, forgotten... Which is why JD will never fall for the muddled tricks and corruption of the DC swamp — and exactly why I know he’s the guy we need in the Senate. JD is running one of the most energized campaigns of this cycle. Because he doesn’t just have something to prove – he’s already done that. No – JD has people to SAVE. Let’s get going. I’m counting on YOU to help me support JD! Thank you, and God Bless, Senator Marco Rubio Paid for by Ohioans for JD Inc., a joint fundraising committee authorized by and comprised of JD Vance for Senate Inc. and Working for Ohio. name: Morton Blackwell
subject: Please see – FW: URGENT: Do we have any more scholarships?
body:
I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below.
|
---
| | | [](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkE1rhDAQhn-N3pSYaFwPHha6e-oupRVKTzImsxoaNSQjpf--sdR7IZfMMx8vj2610lCo1LSccc4kF0VdlUWTDxJPrBR1_MnqpDApGVj0lHt022CNgoUgfD5WrzBX65xObQWVHqAqBqkbfJyaoWwkq3WlS1AMSkjfb_0NjDXLeIcZW0-P3od-gd6aLKhpteAz8gjUy4yLjPOep7adiFxIxDnh1_gCqs2jzi2CRh8m48wSyNBGmK9-jB3fNhzbdryPietGcx_WLYZNxJPza3CoKAZJuNzRjNpsc0Q4x4B_RQWzAzMusbzLuX88vx1kXQgXiqB7vZy72-XeZS_n7LW7ZofG2AnOIdh96THOWCFS32r3Zaw1QdbR6rhf_DVI_zLyA7uIjr4) Fellow Conservative, I just received an urgent request from my staff on behalf of 50 young conservatives. I’ve forwarded it to you below. My name is Morton Blackwell, president of the **Leadership Institute**. This organization is America’s premier training organization for conservatives. The Leadership Institute’s flagship training program is coming up in a few days. This National Youth Leadership School provides the “bootcamp of politics” for young conservatives. Here, we help college students become the next generation of conservative leaders. My staffer Bryan, who oversees the Leadership Institute’s campus programs, sent an urgent email to let me know **the demand by students to attend this special training greatly exceeded expectations.** More than 350 dedicated conservative students have applied to attend. This would be by far my largest Youth Leadership School ever. My staff secured the faculty resources and classroom space to meet the high demand. **But the rise in travel costs from inflation have exhausted the student scholarship funds.** The Leadership Institute provides scholarships to students to cover all travel and housing costs to attend this crucial training in Arlington, Virginia. As I see it, **financial burdens should never hold a young person back from learning to champion the principles that make America great. I hope you’ll agree with me on that.** The students applying for this program are some of the best and brightest young conservatives in America. They’re eager to spend their 4th of July weekend to learn to make a difference for their principles. These young people are the future leaders of our conservative movement and our country. I don’t want to have to turn a single one of them away because they can’t afford to travel here for their training. Here’s where you come in. **Will you make a special gift right now to make sure every young conservative who wants to can afford to attend this crucial training?** [ **Yes, I'll give a special gift for the scholarship fund** ](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkE1rhDAQhn-N3pSYaFwPHha6e-oupRVKTzImsxoaNSQjpf--sdR7IZfMMx8vj2610lCo1LSccc4kF0VdlUWTDxJPrBR1_MnqpDApGVj0lHt022CNgoUgfD5WrzBX65xObQWVHqAqBqkbfJyaoWwkq3WlS1AMSkjfb_0NjDXLeIcZW0-P3od-gd6aLKhpteAz8gjUy4yLjPOep7adiFxIxDnh1_gCqs2jzi2CRh8m48wSyNBGmK9-jB3fNhzbdryPietGcx_WLYZNxJPza3CoKAZJuNzRjNpsc0Q4x4B_RQWzAzMusbzLuX88vx1kXQgXiqB7vZy72-XeZS_n7LW7ZofG2AnOIdh96THOWCFS32r3Zaw1QdbR6rhf_DVI_zLyA7uIjr4) Due to inflation, the total cost for a student scholarship has risen to $1,200 for travel and housing. That’s a significant amount for any one person to give, so I’m asking many other generous conservatives besides you. My goal today is to have 50 conservatives step up to give gifts of $25 each to cover the cost of one more student scholarship. **Will you give $25, or whatever your best gift may be, to help fund a student scholarship?** If so, please use this link to give online right away: [**https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/yls-scholarship**](http://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyNkE1rhDAQhn-N3pSYaFwPHha6e-oupRVKTzImsxoaNSQjpf--sdR7IZfMMx8vj2610lCo1LSccc4kF0VdlUWTDxJPrBR1_MnqpDApGVj0lHt022CNgoUgfD5WrzBX65xObQWVHqAqBqkbfJyaoWwkq3WlS1AMSkjfb_0NjDXLeIcZW0-P3od-gd6aLKhpteAz8gjUy4yLjPOep7adiFxIxDnh1_gCqs2jzi2CRh8m48wSyNBGmK9-jB3fNhzbdryPietGcx_WLYZNxJPza3CoKAZJuNzRjNpsc0Q4x4B_RQWzAzMusbzLuX88vx1kXQgXiqB7vZy72-XeZS_n7LW7ZofG2AnOIdh96THOWCFS32r3Zaw1QdbR6rhf_DVI_zLyA7uIjr4) Thank you for considering this urgent request to help young conservatives grow into the next generation of conservative leaders for America. Cordially, **Morton C. Blackwell**
President, Leadership Institute
* * *
**From:** Bryan Bernys
**To:** Morton Blackwell
**Subject:** URGENT: Do we have any more scholarships? Morton, I just got confirmation that we can move the National Youth Leadership School to the university auditorium. That takes care of the classroom space issues we had. But now there’s a financial issue. With the increase in travel costs, we’ve used up everything in the scholarship fund for students’ travel and hotel rooms. My team still have **50 more applications** to process from students who want to come to the training. Is there any room left in the budget for more student travel scholarships? I don’t want to have to tell my team to turn students away who can’t afford to come, but there’s no other option if we can’t get more scholarship funding. Please let me know how to proceed as soon as possible. Respectfully, Bryan \--
**Bryan Bernys**
Vice President for the Campus Leadership Program
Leadership Institute
---
| | The Leadership Institute 1101 N. Highland St. Steven P.J. Wood Building Arlington VA 22201 United States

In TX-23, I’m running against Republican incumbent Tony Gonzales in the district that just suffered the most deadly mass shooting in 10 years. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46884554/352172305/1015513502?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYmE2NGY0NS0zZmYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=s_3-laQqN5jVoQ6J5HP-5qee0zUpb1g9W7j-ZTiYjvs=&emci=22a1e383-3af3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=fba64f45-3ff3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25686212) Peter, In TX-23, I’m running against Republican incumbent Tony Gonzales in the district that just suffered the most deadly mass shooting in 10 years. Tony's response was "not today." Last year Tony Gonzales voted against both the Bipartisan Background Checks Act and the Violence Against Women Act, as well as stripping Red Flag Laws. Just a few weeks after the massacre at Robb Elementary, he voted against the Protecting Our Children Act and gleefully pushed for "No mandatory waiting, No hardware bans, No age bans, No universal background checks, No Charleston loophole." [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46884555/352172306/-341132363?refcode=em20220623&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYmE2NGY0NS0zZmYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=s_3-laQqN5jVoQ6J5HP-5qee0zUpb1g9W7j-ZTiYjvs=) **Now it’s time for Texans to return the favor and vote no to Tony Gonzales this November.** **[Will you donate to my campaign right now to help me unseat my Republican opponent? I support commonsense gun solutions that will keep American children and families safe. He does not. The choice is clear. With so much at stake, we have no time to waste.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46884556/352172307/-341132363?refcode=em20220623&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYmE2NGY0NS0zZmYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=s_3-laQqN5jVoQ6J5HP-5qee0zUpb1g9W7j-ZTiYjvs=)** Republican leaders like him try to tell us that the only way to protect our Second Amendment Rights is to oppose all gun safety reform measures. I don’t accept that. As a Marine veteran and a gun owner myself, I understand the reasons to possess a firearm. But I also know that we can protect our right to bear arms while doing what it takes to protect our families and communities from being ripped apart by violence. **This is why I am running to represent TX-23.** Because the majority of Americans already support passing gun safety reforms to prevent gun violence, and we deserve to have representatives in Congress who will listen and take action on behalf of our communities. **[If you agree that Americans deserve real representation in Congress, make a donation now. We cannot continue sending people to Washington who will vote with the NRA 100% of the time. We need real leaders who will stand up to the gun lobby and demand immediate change.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46884557/352172308/-341132363?refcode=em20220623&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYmE2NGY0NS0zZmYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=s_3-laQqN5jVoQ6J5HP-5qee0zUpb1g9W7j-ZTiYjvs=)** Every day we wait is a day that more lives will be lost to gun violence. We can do this, together. John Lira | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46884558/352172309/-593876365?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYmE2NGY0NS0zZmYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=s_3-laQqN5jVoQ6J5HP-5qee0zUpb1g9W7j-ZTiYjvs=&emci=22a1e383-3af3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=fba64f45-3ff3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25686212) | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46884559/352172310/-1869672870?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYmE2NGY0NS0zZmYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=s_3-laQqN5jVoQ6J5HP-5qee0zUpb1g9W7j-ZTiYjvs=&emci=22a1e383-3af3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=fba64f45-3ff3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25686212)

| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15526?t=6&akid=3392%2E878179%2EqOoO57) Folks,

I started my campaign to save our democracy from Lauren Boebert's far-right conspiracy theories. But since launching my campaign, I've realized Boebert's bullshit isn't even my biggest obstacle.

Instead, the biggest obstacle to my campaign, and one of the biggest threats to our democracy is...

**MONEY!**

Anyone who wants to win an election in this country needs money.

Which means regular people (me), have to beg you for grassroots support and send you annoying emails like this. _Sorry!_ [**If you believe in my campaign, you can click here to split a donation between my campaign and Voter Protection Project. I appreciate it more than you know.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/15526?t=7&akid=3392%2E878179%2EqOoO57) With the primary only a week away, money's influence on our elections becomes clearer and clearer.

One of my primary opponents is a self-funded career politician, who's poured millions of their own money into boosting their campaign -- and my advisors say that could be enough for them to win the primaries. And yet -- it may not be enough to give Democrats a win in the midterms.

And you know why? _Take a guess._

**That's right -- because Republicans have even more MILLIONS than they do.**

Do you see the problem, folks?

I won't shame anyone for playing the game -- _hello, I 'm doing the same thing_ -- but I won't keep quiet about systemic issues with our democracy. Our elections aren't about who has the best policies or who's popular with voters. At the end of the day, most of the time all that matters is who has the most money.

**If we care about having free and fair elections, we need MAJOR reform to the entire voting system.**

If I win this race, I will do everything I can to ensure that future elections are accessible to anyone who has the vision to lead.

But I won't be able to do it if I don't win. -Alex

You might have been astonished when you saw Georgia flip blue in the 2020

Georgia?

Stacey has spent her entire career fighting for voting rights and laying
the foundation that has made progress in the Peach State possible.

That’s why I’m proud to stand with Stacey Abrams in her campaign for
Governor of Georgia — and that’s why I’m asking you to join me!

power Stacey’s campaign for One Georgia today? Anything you can give will

stakes are far too high to stay on the sidelines.

The actions of Georgia’s current governor have increased anxiety for so
many of the men, women, and children he’s supposed to be helping.

* He passed one of the most extreme abortion bans in the nation.
* He made it easier for criminals to carry concealed weapons.
* He refuses to expand health care access for Georgians.
* And he has worked to suppress voters at every turn.

Why does he want to make it MORE DIFFICULT for some people to vote?

Thanks in part to Stacey’s ability to organize voters, Georgia will
continue to be a battleground state during the 2024 election and beyond.
When we hear pundits’ gloomy predictions, we know they’ve been wrong
before, so we can’t agonize. We need to ORGANIZE. And Stacey is so good at
that!

Starting right now, we ALL need to do our part to help her expand the
movement for progress in Georgia. No amount of time or money is too small.
We ALL need to do whatever we can to make sure that Stacey Abrams wins by
a margin too big to credibly dispute.

Stacey Abrams has a record of elevating people.
Her opponent has a record of crushing people.

That’s why I’m doing my part to help her grassroots team get all the
resources they need to ensure her decisive victory. And that’s why I’m
asking YOU to join me today.

first donation to
Stacey Abrams’ campaign right now?

I know these are challenging times, and that’s why I’m supporting Stacey
Abrams. Thank you so much for joining me in this fight. It matters.

All my best to you and your family,

-Carole

| | **Schmidt: Working with the Legislature, not against it, yields successes for Kansas** Derek SchmidtLetter to the Editor, _The Mercury_ Each year as attorney general, I have proposed legislation to make our state better and then worked cooperatively with legislators to get the job done. This year, I’m particularly grateful for the bipartisan support many of our proposals received. For example:

**Debt & savings:** Before legislators convened, I recommended using at least $1 billion of the state’s current budget surplus to prepay debt owed to the Kansas Public Employees Retirement System (KPERS). This saves taxpayers hundreds of millions of dollars in future debt service while further securing the pensions owed to thousands of police, firefighters, teachers and other public retirees. I also recommended setting aside not less than $500 million in a rainy-day fund to help stabilize state services when the next economic downturn inevitably comes. The Legislature did both.

**Food & fence taxes:** Last fall, I recommended reducing or eliminating the state sales tax on groceries and sales tax relief for fencing supplies needed to rebuild wildfire-damaged farms and ranches. Both got done.

**Child pornography offenders:** We discovered a loophole in state law that allowed offenders who trade online visual depictions of child sexual abuse to avoid registering as sex offenders. We recommended closing that loophole, and the Legislature agreed. Now, anyone convicted of trading child pornography must register as a sex offender.

**Sex Offender Civil Commitment:** For years, the state’s process for committing sexually violent predators for treatment at Larned State Hospital sometimes resulted in lengthy periods of detention in county jails not well-suited to house them. We helped the Legislature reform that process to more quickly move these violent predators out of county jails and to Larned at less cost to local property taxpayers.

**Sanctuary cities:** When a local government adopted an ordinance to hamper law enforcement cooperation with immigration authorities, I recommended state law to prevent local political interference with law enforcement. The Legislature agreed. The measure also helps fight identity theft and reinforces election integrity by limiting the use of local-government identification cards for local purposes.

**Drug-treatment prison:** For many years, I have worked to establish a dedicated drug-treatment prison for Kansas. Certain offenders whose misbehavior is caused by addiction – think burglars who repeatedly steal to buy drugs – would be sentenced to a specialized prison for intensive drug treatment while incarcerated. The goal is to change future behavior. We finally got that done and this year obtained funding to operate the new 240-bed facility at Lansing.

**Rules & regulations oversight:** After I joined in proposing a ‘legislative veto’ over state agency rules and regulations, the Legislature put that question on the ballot for voters to decide in November. The people through their elected legislators – not unelected government employees – should have the final say on agency regulations. After all, the Legislature gave the agency power to regulate in the first place.

**Elected sheriffs:** Sheriffs are uniquely accountable law enforcement officials because they are elected by the people. I was pleased to work closely with the Kansas Sheriffs Association as they proposed to secure our current system of electing sheriffs; the Legislature agreed, and voters will decide in November.

**Sexual assault kits:** When I began serving as attorney general, Kansas had a large backlog of untested sexual assault kits collected by law enforcement agencies statewide. We worked diligently and collaboratively to eliminate that backlog, and now – thanks to legislation we backed this year – Kansas law requires kits be submitted for testing so the backlog never happens again.

Despite the record number of vetoes by our governor, not everything in Topeka needs to be as cantankerous as it may appear. Working effectively and professionally with legislators can accomplish good things for Kansas.

–Derek Schmidt _Attorney General and Republican candidate for governor_ [**_Click here to read the full letter to the editor in the Mercury_**](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=7367d02a1cc14faeb70fd1647558092e&_e=RfI6xlQpsL3eq3J6M9H8L4-dv8pu-G4t4QJ8kGc6k7CXvImCL8yDeMnW6PgaTiJOyHxiSGThDR47mr72DZ4LosHbicL_iqJJRpr_x3iZo4KjqOOnepCIu22LsT9E3dePFxRfU3_Tn7go3X5VhjveTnkgI3cL_SMww9Zggh74Ds0hH2lsDy3wSOprnmw-tbgM9UR0m2AmTzvzz6KKiin5fWHM4DcJ1OYYf_HYEwqd6q7WXz6YStCcvGV3oCyl8uMLzbiWWRFTn8rn1QD-HjFtuESRfyjVLdFUk0GnEFyxhHuCKOHr84dOyONc87ExCxjeR7-8Y1s9-YYY_VOMTlsaVxDXPxWGWNQLJhhRbJfC_F9SJIjdv8iJLoXY8y1nPfupIlqhp8A0ij8RLnh-hsCGkA%3D%3D)

Peter, hours ago, the Supreme Court handed down a decision that overturned a century-old commonsense gun control law in New York. While our state's robust gun laws remain intact, including the overall concealed carry restrictions, this decision is incredibly disappointing.
But our fight to end gun violence does not stop here. When I was elected attorney general, I promised to do everything in my power to protect New Yorkers from this epidemic, and today's bleak decision has only reaffirmed my commitment to the cause.
**That’s why, over the next several days, my office will take action to address all of the potential harm that may come from this decision.** I will fight to ensure that our robust gun protection laws remain intact, and I will continue to stand up to the gun lobby to protect families both in New York and in every corner of the country.
Peter, this decision may feel like a setback in our fight to end gun violence, but I vow to keep fighting until the end. And as we learn more about the impact that this disappointing decision will have on our communities, I hope you’ll stay in this fight with me.
Thank you for your commitment to a future free of gun violence. Our hard work continues, but with your ongoing support, I’m positive that this future is within our reach.

Letitia

| | | Dear Friend, I'm going to share something important with you: we are expecting voter turnout this cycle to be __**significantly** __ lower than last cycle. Why? Three reasons: 1) It's a midterm election year, so fewer people are paying attention. 2) The timing is unusual – Maryland virtually never has elections in July, and we only do this year because a redistricting lawsuit postponed the date. 3) Unlike last cycle, the Board of Elections isn't automatically mailing ballots to all registered voters. Instead, voters have to manually request a mail-in ballot in order to receive one. A lower-turnout election presents a window of opportunity for a grassroots campaign like ours. But it also means we need to devote extra effort to turning our voters out. Mckayla is in the community every day, talking to people who aren't used to being listened to. Folks in Maryland's 5th are ready for some damn change – **but we need them to vote.** ****[**Today, we are launching our Get-Out-The-Vote fund. The Mandy Connell Show on 850 KOA (850AM or 94.1FM) isn't your grandpa's talk radio show. Host Mandy Connell is a rabble-rouser and champion who loves a good discussion. She will make you think and she will make you laugh.

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in June of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

subject: Subject: Endorsement Alert: National Border Patrol Council Endorses Tanya
disclaimer_text: Paid for and Authorized by Tanya for Arizona
body:
BIG news this morning from Team Tanya! The National Border Patrol Council announced their endorsement of Tanya in the AZ-04 congressional race. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/1077c5a2c9c3/team-tanya-alert-former-senator-jon-kyl-endorses-tanya-wheeless-7239289?e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| | |
---
| | | Hi Friend, BIG news this morning from Team Tanya! The National Border Patrol Council announced their endorsement of Tanya in the AZ-04 congressional race.

_“Tanya has already taken two trips to the border since announcing her run for Congress, showing her commitment to assessing the border crisis firsthand and her determination to find meaningful solutions,”_ **said National Border Patrol Council President Brandon Judd.**

_“After looking at all of the candidates in the AZ-04 congressional race, Tanya stands out as the only one we can trust to take real action in Congress to secure our border and to be an advocate for federal law enforcement. She will make sure our members have the policy, resources and training they need and the respect they deserve._

_With drugs and criminals pouring across our border in record numbers, we need a strong, thoughtful leader to represent us in Washington, and that’s why on behalf of the men and women of the National Border Patrol Council, we are pleased to give Tanya Contreras Wheeless our full support in her race for Congress in Arizona’s 4 th District.”_
[**Join the National Border Patrol Council in Supporting Tanya by Liking and Sharing their Endorsement.**](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=664d62ea40&e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| [ ](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=57f7cc978a&e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| The National Border Patrol Council joins Tanya Contreras Wheeless’ growing list of endorsements, including the Phoenix Law Enforcement Association, the Congressional Leadership Fund, Chair Elise Stefanik, Winning for Women, Senator Martha McSally, Senator Jon Kyl, Young Guns’ “On the Radar” list, VIEWPAC and Maggie’s List.

Best,
Team Tanya
---
| \--
More about Tanya:

**_Tanya Contreras Wheeless_** launched her campaign for U.S. Congress in August 2021. She is a proven leader with a track record of bringing people together to solve problems. Her vast professional experience includes lawyer, business association CEO, sports executive with the Phoenix Suns, small business owner, and community advocate.

A valley native, she was born to teen parents and is the granddaughter of immigrants. She grew up in a working-class family that often struggled, but despite the challenges, she learned the importance of faith, family, hard work, and personal responsibility.

Driven by her desire to create a better life for herself, Tanya worked from the time she was 14. She put herself through Arizona State University, becoming the first person in her family to graduate from college. She went on to graduate from ASU Law with distinction, earning a job at one of the nation’s top law firms.

Now, Tanya is ready to bring her experience and thoughtful leadership to Congress. She believes in the promise of the American dream and will fight to preserve it. She will embrace policies that empower people, not the government. And, she will always put Arizona first.

Tanya lives in Tempe with her husband Steve, an attorney and former F-16 pilot in the U.S. Air Force. They have three wonderful children and two dogs who keep them on their toes.
---
| | | _The Tanya for Arizona campaign is about what WE CAN do together. WE CAN defend opportunity and freedom, but Tanya will need your help. No act of support is too small so please join our movement today by
[_DONATING_](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=0b16310f1d&e=bd2b55b0e3) or _[VOLUNTEERING](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=4b89738864&e=bd2b55b0e3)_._

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s less than 6 hours until our critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $50,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**
[**Please, may I count on you to make a donation to my campaign today – before our fundraising deadline? He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. There’s less than 6 hours until our critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $50,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask: = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = With Senate control on the line, I am so grateful to have the support of people like you. I think my mom and dad would appreciate the support, as well. Thank you, Mike Franken, VADM, U.S. Navy (ret.) We’re in for a tough fight.
#
Hey Derek,
We can’t ignore what’s happening on the other side of the aisle.
Apparently, Republican turnout in last month’s election was the highest of *any* primary (including the 2012 presidential nominating contest) except for 2016. _That's looking at data from the last 25 years._
Here’s what that means: **PA’s Republican voters are registered, energized, and ready to show up to the polls in November.**
If we’re going to outmatch them to flip this highly competitive Senate seat blue — in a midterm election, no less — we’ll need to double down on our investments in voter registration + mobilization across all 67 counties of Pennsylvania.
[**_Please, Derek, can you donate $5 or more to help reach voters, send John to Washington, and keep the Senate blue in 2022?_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220623-1?refcode=em20220623-6293&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6293_434096_sBEnhn&akid=6293%2E434096%2EsBEnhn)
**[Donate now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220623-1?refcode=em20220623-6293&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6293_434096_sBEnhn&akid=6293%2E434096%2EsBEnhn)**
**Two years ago, Joe Biden won Pennsylvania by just 1% in a year with record turnout.** Republicans were pretty pissed off by that, as you may have noticed. So in addition to spreading Trump’s Big Lie + contesting legitimate election results, they’ve also been making serious investments in registering + mobilizing their base.
**The historic turnout we just saw in the GOP primary should be a big wake-up call.** If we don’t pick up the pace in our organizing, we risk being overwhelmed by a red wave in November. 🔴
But it definitely doesn’t have to be that way, Derek!! If we’re clear-eyed about the challenges we face, we can raise enough grassroots resources to turn out ALL sorts of voters — rural and urban, younger and older, even first-time — to show up in November + elect John.
[**_Please make a $5 donation to help us counteract Republicans’ attempts to elect Dr. Oz + turn PA permanently red. Every dollar counts in a race like this._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220623-1?refcode=em20220623-6293&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6293_434096_sBEnhn&akid=6293%2E434096%2EsBEnhn)

Thank you,
Team Fetterman

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220623-6293-footer&t=1&refcode2=6293_434096_sBEnhn&akid=6293%2E434096%2EsBEnhn)**

## MISERY INDEX UPDATED: UNPRECEDENTED DEPTHS OF ECONOMIC DESPAIR SHOWN IN COLORADO, NATIONWIDE
---
|
---
| | The 1970s Misery Index was crafted to measure suffering and economic distress among America's working and middle class. Tim's new research expands the index and shows that economic conditions, combined with drug and alcohol use and rising crime rates, have Coloradans and all Americans facing unprecedented depths of despair.
Tim's research combines inflation and unemployment figures, drug and alcohol deaths, crime rates, and home affordability (housing price index divided by median household income levels) from 2000 through April of this year.
The result is a stark illustration of how the American condition has rapidly declined since President Joe Biden took office.
The Misery Index is designed to be 100%, while values above 100% are worse than average (more misery) and values below 100% are better than average (less misery). The higher the index climbs, the more miserable the circumstances consumers are facing.
Inflation has spiked from 1.28% to 8.22% nationwide since Trump's last month in office, and in Colorado it jumped from 1.52% to 7.63%. By April of this year, the Misery Index had spiked to 163.2% nationwide, and 164.4% in Colorado.
What is needed now are thoughtful solutions and quick action by Congress to fix the economy, secure our border, and get crime under control. This includes putting a check on Biden's reckless spending that's fueling inflation, cracking down on drug trafficking at the border, and reclassifying fentanyl from a misdemeanor to a felony. Tim Reichert is the only candidate who has a plan to address these issues. View Tim's Handshake with the Middle Class [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001x_HlLfRCvhV9PUIhyfF6fX451UiJ7IIvML7MzLf3aW3PlibxhKLpFBRXVe0P6gl175Tg3IDtfH4qoQ1axnx0TcKASA6ZKivY1FWOqIWI28S98LZcKWHCNID33TEqYtiYHby3EGCMWecGsEVo1s1or4-qIl2iOt7h79_5_6Bu5ikim3vxodiL4ZSey-mjoPduE40KwuTp07WUPtRuA8BTFREJ8rtxRVGmQcC8RgyMcj7Zf2Kh_xhdDAVWrV3n59bIFrD50QAdKxo=&c=fdv5dVPKAZMO-dIDpBU__nuB4mOFnx6SmPchzW9BFWBTyfpKQjEZyA==&ch=hgR-E2zAgOAGyIY7CiJlbxrxVjWoleAEbFV7QgAOOe94IK_-GhuTzg==).

Tim participated in the CD7 Republican debate sponsored by the Jeffco House District Captains, where several students asked great questions and topics ranged from education and the economy to international affairs and healthcare. It’s John Fetterman, Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania + Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate. 😁 I know that Elizabeth Warren is grateful for all the ways you’ve fought by her side — and she said I could drop you a line and talk about our plans to fight for working families together in the Senate. I’m gonna talk about growing up in PA, but first, I have to ask: [_**Can you split $3 between me and Elizabeth Warren so we can fight side by side in the Senate for working families? I’m *so* grateful for your support (even if you think Wawa > Sheetz).**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46889037/352188976/87291130?refcode=EM1F_TAN_O_20220623_V1S3_full&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWEzMTA3ZS01MGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NlAFlv7R2Lhp3dpjoevr8_s6TAsOKhAJuxMo4ODy0iA=) Ok, now onto the good stuff. I was born in Reading, Pennsylvania when my parents were just two teenagers starting out on their own. I love my parents, even if my wife Gisele is their favorite. 🙄 We started out struggling. My dad was a union grocery worker at ShopRite, working night shifts. The union way of life helped keep our family together while he went to college. Dad ended up graduating, and got a good job as an underwriter. After we moved, I grew up in suburban south central Pennsylvania. I graduated from Central York High School and went to college in Reading, just like my dad did. When I left Pennsylvania for grad school, I *never* envisioned myself ending up in public service — not as Mayor of Braddock for 15 years, and certainly not as Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania. Also I, uh, looked like this at the time. 👇 [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46889038/352188977/87291130?refcode=EM1F_TAN_O_20220623_V1S3_full&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWEzMTA3ZS01MGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NlAFlv7R2Lhp3dpjoevr8_s6TAsOKhAJuxMo4ODy0iA=) **But I came back to Pennsylvania because that's where my heart is.** And alongside my amazing wife, Gisele, I have dedicated my life to improving our Commonwealth. When Pennsylvania lawmakers pushed outdated, discriminatory policies banning marriage equality, I officiated one of the first gay marriages in Pennsylvania. 🌈 When Braddock was overlooked and counted out, we created jobs and got young people engaged. We created a community center, urban gardens, and a free store run by Gisele. ✊ And when the Pennsylvania GOP sent their flag police to take down my Legal Weed + Pride flags, I put them back up. I’m just gonna keep doing that. ✅ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46889039/352188978/87291130?refcode=EM1F_TAN_O_20220623_V1S3_full&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWEzMTA3ZS01MGYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NlAFlv7R2Lhp3dpjoevr8_s6TAsOKhAJuxMo4ODy0iA=) [_**If that’s the kind of never-give-up attitude you want to see in the U.S. Senate, can you chip in $10 for me and Warren Democrats today? To be successful, we’re gonna need to build a huge campaign across all 67 counties in Pennsylvania. I’m gonna talk about growing up in PA, but first, I have to ask: = Ok, now onto the good stuff. I was born in Reading, Pennsylvania when my parents were just two teenagers starting out on their own. I love my parents, even if my wife Gisele is their favorite. 🙄 We started out struggling. My dad was a union grocery worker at ShopRite, working night shifts. The union way of life helped keep our family together while he went to college. Dad ended up graduating, and got a good job as an underwriter. After we moved, I grew up in suburban south central Pennsylvania. I graduated from Central York High School and went to college in Reading, just like my dad did. When I left Pennsylvania for grad school, I never envisioned myself ending up in public service — not as Mayor of Braddock for 15 years, and certainly not as Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania. Also I, uh, looked like this at the time. 👇 = But I came back to Pennsylvania because that's where my heart is. And alongside my amazing wife, Gisele, I have dedicated my life to improving our Commonwealth. When Pennsylvania lawmakers pushed outdated, discriminatory policies banning marriage equality, I officiated one of the first gay marriages in Pennsylvania. 🌈 When Braddock was overlooked and counted out, we created jobs and got young people engaged. We created a community center, urban gardens, and a free store run by Gisele. ✊ And when the Pennsylvania GOP sent their flag police to take down my Legal Weed + Pride flags, I put them back up. The way people lose is to forget who they are, where they come from and who they represent. I’ve seen former colleagues make this mistake before; I made a vow to myself to never become complacent. So, here we are once again, five months until Election Day, and if we learned anything from the Supreme Court leak last week, the entire political landscape can be changed by a single event. I’m gearing up for the election to safe this country, and I’m asking if you have the time, please consider doing so today. Please help me reach our goal of finding 20,000 endorsements by the end of this week. We’re just 1,408 short at the moment, but we’re confident that the hill isn’t too steep. Let’s get this done. Thanks, Jim Don't want to receive our emails? | Paid for by Jim Jordan for Congress PO BOX 355 Delaware, OH 43015

Hello there,

I’m Lieutenant Colonel (Retired) Alexander Vindman, and I served more than
20 years in the U.S. Army and as the Director for European Affairs for the
United States National Security Council until 2020.

I’m writing to you because our country is at a crossroads, and two paths
lie before us: one leads towards a better, more equitable future for all
Americans—the other jeopardizes the very foundations upon which our
democracy is built.

I’m supporting Tim Ryan for Senate in Ohio because he recognizes that his
duty as an elected official is to fight on behalf of those he represents.
[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/15457?t=1015&amount=25&akid=4315%2E3611125%2E89_jdi ]Will you show your support for Tim by making a $25 contribution to his
campaign?

What happened on January 6th was nothing short of an existential crisis
for the United States, and if we fail to recognize and remedy how we got
there, we’re surely doomed to repeat it.

But there are people in Washington, and others running for office, who
seek to further undermine our democracy by casting a shadow over the
legitimacy of our elections, stripping Americans of their fundamental
rights.

JD Vance is one of those people—he didn’t create the MAGA movement, but
his shameless attempts to curry favor with Donald Trump and the Trump base
is part of the hyperpolarization tearing this country and our communities
apart.

Tim Ryan is the opposite: he puts the people he represents first, and he’s
a fierce fighter for hardworking Americans.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/15457?t=1007&amount=25&akid=4315%2E3611125%2E89_jdi ]Washington could use more people like Tim, and I’m hoping you’ll join
me in supporting him. Can I count on you to make a donation to his
campaign for Senate?

subject: Only in Alaska!
body:
The sudden withdrawal by candidate Al Gross has changed the dynamics of this special election and the subsequent regular election race. | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | |
### Dear Friend,

After the second posting of the election results, I sought respite in southwest Alaska to enjoy being on the land and water. As so many Alaskans know, connecting with the land and water is spiritual and healing in so many ways. I was completely out of cell range and I embraced the break from connectivity. Imagine my surprise when I returned to Anchorage, only to have my phone full of text messages from across Alaska informing me of the unexpected twist in this special election. The sudden withdrawal by candidate Al Gross has changed the dynamics of this special election and the subsequent regular election race.

There is controversy and debate over whether I should be allowed to fill that 4th place spot. I believe that under the law, I should advance into the final four.

AS 15.25.100 (a) as written, clearly states that the director of the Division of Elections "shall place the names of the four candidates receiving the greatest number of votes for an office." As the candidate with the fifth highest votes, I strongly believe that I should fill the vacancy left by Al Gross.

AS 15.25.100 (c) also states that "if a candidate nominated at the primary election dies, withdraws, resigns, becomes disqualified from holding office for which the candidate is nominated, or is certified as being incapacitated in the manner prescribed by this section after the primary election and _**64 or more days before the general election**_ , the vacancy shall be filled by the director by replacing the withdrawn candidate with the candidate who received the fifth most votes in the primary election."

It is clear that the intent of the law, passed through ballot initiative, is to have at least four candidates from which to choose during the general election. The need for clarity is whether the 64 day trigger applies to the special election. The law does not delineate between special or regular elections, yet elsewhere within Alaska election law, special election is clearly defined.

Providing that information, it is important that I share with you that **my campaign will not intervene in litigation** on this issue. **This is a procedural challenge, a referendum of the system and not my personal campaign.** I was not involved in Ballot Measure 2. I think it is more appropriate for those that have been involved in this change to Alaska's election laws to defend the substance of the law.

**I am personally concerned that Nick Begich III** sought immediate relief to block the advancement of my candidacy and **_limit_ the choices for Alaskans. **While disappointing, it is not surprising that Nick Begich III has taken this posture, he has stated time and again his desire to limit the choices for women everywhere, including Alaska. He is clearly threatened by my candidacy and for good reason. I am focused on empowerment, bringing people together and doing what is right for Alaska.

Whether the decision by the Division of Elections stands, or there is a legal challenge, I respect the process.

I respect that I am currently in 5th place and Alaskans are facing a ranked choice voting structure. However, **make no mistake** , if I am advanced to the final four, I will bring my Alaskan fighting spirit to the center stage.

With gratitude,

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46890075/352213699/333259033?refcode=em_220623_pridestory_rsnd&sourceid=1030989&ms=em_220623_pridestory_rsnd&refcode2=8dcaa4d9-59f3-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGNhYTRkOS01OWYzLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pdm0GRWRs1Yg1CfrIvJpu_cBcgT3bm6dNU2mYKwkQKY=)

| | Dear friends, You might not know this, but I was co-chair of the Lancaster County _Republican_ Party in the 1980s. I was energized by the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of working families, small business owners, and neighbors who needed a helping hand. It was a role I gratefully accepted because I love Nebraska, and I thought it was the best way to use my voice for good. **But when my nephew came out as gay in 1989 — and I had the audacity to love him anyway — I was ostracized by some of my fellow Republicans.** It was a wake-up call I couldn’t ignore. _How could we claim to serve _all_ Nebraskans, yet believe that simply loving someone of the same gender makes a person unworthy of support from their own family?_ These were people I once called friends — but they turned their backs on me for _refusing to turn my back_ on a family member. **It was then that I decided: No matter the party, and no matter the person, I would always fight with every bone in my body for _every_ Nebraskan’s right to have a voice and to live authentically.** I changed my party affiliation because I couldn’t support the marginalization of people like my nephew. And despite the different letter behind my name, my commitment to equality before the law has remained steadfast. Years later, when my oldest son came out, there was never a question in my mind that I would unconditionally love and celebrate the person he is. My son Taylor inspires me to work even harder for the rights of all LGBTQ+ Americans — I’m fighting as fiercely as only a mom can. **I walked away from bigotry and didn’t look back. clean_body: Why I left the Republican Party (a Pride story) | = | | Dear friends, You might not know this, but I was co-chair of the Lancaster County Republican Party in the 1980s. I was energized by the opportunity to make a difference in the lives of working families, small business owners, and neighbors who needed a helping hand. It was a role I gratefully accepted because I love Nebraska, and I thought it was the best way to use my voice for good. But when my nephew came out as gay in 1989 — and I had the audacity to love him anyway — I was ostracized by some of my fellow Republicans. It was a wake-up call I couldn’t ignore. How could we claim to serve all Nebraskans, yet believe that simply loving someone of the same gender makes a person unworthy of support from their own family? These were people I once called friends — but they turned their backs on me for refusing to turn my back on a family member. It was then that I decided: No matter the party, and no matter the person, I would always fight with every bone in my body for every Nebraskan’s right to have a voice and to live authentically. I changed my party affiliation because I couldn’t support the marginalization of people like my nephew. And despite the different letter behind my name, my commitment to equality before the law has remained steadfast. Years later, when my oldest son came out, there was never a question in my mind that I would unconditionally love and celebrate the person he is. My son Taylor inspires me to work even harder for the rights of all LGBTQ+ Americans — I’m fighting as fiercely as only a mom can. I walked away from bigotry and didn’t look back. I know I’m not the only Nebraskan who has made that journey. I’m running for Congress to represent the current reality of our communities: Nebraskans are warm, diverse, and open-minded. name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: The DCCC just raised $11.8 million
body:
#
Peter,
**We operate on a pretty tight budget, especially compared to other political organizations.** It’s because we run solely on donations from grassroots supporters like you. We don’t and we won’t ever take a cent from corporate PACs.
Our average contribution this month is just $15.97. And we’re proud of that number because it means we rely on a lot of small-dollar donations to fund our work to transform the Democratic Party.
**In April, the DCCC raised $11.8 million** — that is a whole lotta money to support entrenched incumbents and Nancy Pelosi’s corporate agenda. Our goal this end-of-quarter is to raise 1.01% of what the DCCC raised in April.
[Thank you for being a part of this movement – we’re so appreciative that you’re with us. Will you make your first contribution today to help us reach our $120,000 end-of-quarter goal? Whether you can make a first time gift of $3 or $50 — every single donation makes a difference.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110810?refcode=em20220623-23983&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=23983%2E1203867%2EKYexCs)
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110810?refcode=em20220623-23983&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=23983%2E1203867%2EKYexCs)**
We launched Justice Democrats in 2018 after many of our staff members worked on Bernie Sanders’ presidential campaign. We were all inspired and determined to find a way to continue the message of Bernie’s campaign through electing a new Congress that truly represented the needs of the people.
From helping AOC win in 2018 to recruiting fearless leaders like Jamaal Bowman and Cori Bush to run and win, we’re making real change and shifting the Democratic Party to truly represent the people.
We’re exactly one week out from our next end-of-quarter deadline, which is especially important for us because of our quarterly budgeting process. Reaching our goal this month will set us up for success for the next three months.
[In order to continue winning races against the deep-pocketed corporate-backed Democratic establishment, we need the help of our grassroots supporters to reach our end-of-quarter goal. Can you chip in $3 to help us run strong campaigns and elect more Justice Democrats?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110810?refcode=em20220623-23983&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=23983%2E1203867%2EKYexCs)
Thank you so much for your support, we’re so thankful that you’re a part of this movement.
In solidarity,
Team JD

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=22&akid=23983%2E1203867%2EKYexCs) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=23&akid=23983%2E1203867%2EKYexCs) and your state public health department.
---

---
| | Dear Friend, As the nation crumbles under failed leadership, the Biden administration is short on answers— and our “watch dog” mainstream media is behaving more like a puppy dog catering to its master. But I’m not afraid to call all of them out, and neither is the Republican National Committee. This recent update was supplied by the RNC, and I wanted to share it with you to show just what Republicans are up against in Washington. The RNC is right — the Biden administration doesn’t know what they’re talking about!

We are just 5 members short of flipping the House of Representatives and reversing the course of Joe Biden’s lunacy. [Click here](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-274-b2920e91f4-jcbe1d31c8) to join our movement, and don’t forget to check out the RNC’s hit list below.
---
Sincerely,
---
---
|
---
| | In Karine Jean-Pierre’s 37 days**** as Biden’s press secretary, she’s had a lot to say – but [very few answers](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-275-237dec1478-jcbe1d31c8).
* **On the**[**baby formula**](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-275-237dec1478-jcbe1d31c8)**shortage:**[“I don’t have a timeline.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-276-6de48ed886-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On gas prices:** [“I don’t have anything specific.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-277-3af4425651-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On domestic energy production:**[“I don’t have anything specific.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-278-c12d0bddf6-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On Biden’s**[**false claim**](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-279-72ead5aa10-jcbe1d31c8)**he was appointed to the Naval Academy:**[“I did not hear that.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-280-c6026b0a24-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On whether Biden was wrong about inflation:** [She laughed](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-281-6588ea70b8-jcbe1d31c8).
* **On solar panels:** [She sighed](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-282-2046920706-jcbe1d31c8).
* **On 401(k)s “getting wiped out”:**[She sighed again](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-283-69c694681e-jcbe1d31c8).
* **On Kamala Harris’s new “disinformation” task force:**[“I would need to talk to her team.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-284-4f3f010c2d-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On cash payments to illegal immigrants:**[“I don’t understand the question.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-285-d3e82103d9-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On Biden’s botched Afghanistan withdrawal:** [“I’ll let Secretary Blinken speak to that.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-286-5aa67f098e-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On Biden’s “stamina, physically and mentally”:**[“Not a question that we should even be asking.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-287-7857c92bd1-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On Biden’s “amazingly low” approval rating** : [She dodged](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-288-b3a5f33657-jcbe1d31c8).
* **On Biden’s past comments about Saudi Arabia** : [She dodged again](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-289-0e79ca88b9-jcbe1d31c8).
* **On Biden’s COVID testing regimen** : [“I do not have a date for you.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-290-d7f027e468-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On baby formula (again):** [“I know we made some announcements last week](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-291-ce0127b183-jcbe1d31c8), I just don’t have them in front of me.”
* **On Biden’s investigation of mounted Border Patrol horse officers:**[“I don’t have an update on that.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-292-6b50718923-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On Emad Shargi, a U.S. citizen wrongfully detained in Iran:**[No idea](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-292-6b50718923-jcbe1d31c8).
* **On student loan debt cancellation** : [“So, um... we have no policy to announce yet.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-293-9c344218c0-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On the Durham report:**[“I can’t speak to that.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-294-fdcd373a82-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On vaccine requirements for domestic travel:**[“I don’t have anything more to share.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-295-a600296156-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On COVID restrictions:**[“I do not know.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-296-666daf8f37-jcbe1d31c8)
* **On the border wall:**[“I have to look at the comments, I have not seen them.”](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-297-20f293e10b-jcbe1d31c8)

And when she _does_ have answers, they are read directly [from](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-298-8985164a67-jcbe1d31c8) her prepared statements. Of course, it isn’t entirely her fault; she works for an administration that is as [clueless](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-299-2e81cd9a4f-jcbe1d31c8) as they are [incompetent](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-300-b28b61ea9e-jcbe1d31c8). But if Biden is going to continue [dodging](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-301-972e7bf18b-jcbe1d31c8) [the](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-302-f6f964c41e-jcbe1d31c8) [press](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-303-450eec2b3e-jcbe1d31c8), the American people deserve answers. Karine Jean-Pierre [doesn’t have any](https://app.ignitionmail.com/ga/click/2-163077-5-77-147-304-dd1e2d8ab2-jcbe1d31c8).

| | Friend,

You could say our campaign is picking up momentum at the right time!

Over the last two weeks, we've been endorsed by Congressman Adam Kinzinger and the Chicago Tribune, and former Governor of Illinois Jim Edgar suggested that we have the best chance of winning the 13th District in November for Republicans.

**Now today, we want to highlight other campaign supporters. State Representative Mike Marron has endorsed our campaign because he knows our farmers, businesses, and families will have someone who stands up for them in Congress!**
---
|
---
| _“I first met Matt Hausman and his family through the farming community here in Central Illinois. The more I hear from Matt and who he is up against this election, I believe he is the best choice to represent us in Congress. He has seen how the heavy hand of government imposing regulations and taxes hurts our farmers, businesses, and families. Matt isn’t someone who is just going to yell about issues to win an election, he’s a leader who will help everyday people. For that reason, Matt Hausman has my full support.” — _**Local Farmer and State Representative Mike Marron**
_**Fellow Local Supporters**_
* John Brown, Village President of Savoy & Champaign County Sheriff Candidate
* Tom Connors, Illinois Farm Business Farm Management Board Member
* Becky Doyle, Former Illinois Director of Agriculture
* John Farney, Former Champaign County Treasurer
* Jeff Fisher, Champaign County Farm Bureau Political Involvement Committee
* Jon Griffel, Macoupin County Young Ag Leader
* Tony Hausmann, Collinsville City Council
* Brent Johnson, Sangamon County Farm Bureau Board Member
* Lin Warfel, 1989 News-Gazette Farm Leader of the Year and Former Parkland College Trustee
* Von Young, Retired Parkland College Police Chief

---
|
---
| **We are just days away from Election Day so these endorsements come with a lot of weight! Our support is growing and we can win this election with this big swing of momentum.**

[Invest $50 right now](https://HausmanForCongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7e517e9fc38cab3813c9b7d&id=55e8f7c5c9&e=1a73135fac) so we can send out additional text messages, run more digital ads, and make strong final pushes with voters across our 13th District so we can begin to restore the American Dream.

Join Congressman Kinzinger and State Representative Mike Marron in [supporting our campaign by being a campaign contributor here](https://HausmanForCongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3a7e517e9fc38cab3813c9b7d&id=70a1520c09&e=1a73135fac)!

Thank you,

Matt Hausman

Thanks to our generous supporters, we’re launching this program this month. Our research shows that 94 percent of Latino voters who participated in a primary came back to vote in the general election that year. With our primary just six weeks away, we’re focused on Latino community turnout – the more voters we get to show up in the primaries, the more we can count on in the general election to flip Arizona blue. Thanks to turnout among Latinos and other communities of color, we were able to defeat Donald Trump, flip control of the Senate, and win important races up and down the ballot. If we want to win again in 2022, we have to continue to tailor specific voter turnout and voter persuasion messages to all of our diverse constituency groups. That’s why we’re targeting more than 100,000 voters to listen to their concerns, engage with them early, and encourage them to vote in the primary. It’s the best way to ensure another year of record general election turnout, which could be the difference in us turning AZ completely blue or not. body:
Election Day for the Republican Primary is this Tuesday, June 28th, only five days away.

| [ ](http://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/?e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=6_23_newsletter&n=1) | |

[](https://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYoACmWpbFVl5yir_lA0uM2Gq9g9n79yo2HHshKvg7nExCdQZseeTdqQcxnA0-13oGA&e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=6_23_newsletter&n=2) Dear Peter -- Election Day for the Republican Primary is this Tuesday, June 28th, only five days away. We’re nearing the end of the road: this election will determine which candidate will challenge J.B. Pritzker for governor. We can’t count on candidates like former Democrat Richard Irvin or career politician Darren Bailey to beat Pritzker. We don’t need another politician in office. We need an outsider with real experience who will bring real results, and that person is Gary Rabine! This election is an unusual one. We were originally supposed to vote in March, but it was postponed to June by Governor Prizker due to a delay in census data for redistricting. Because of this, voter turnout for early in-person voting has been remarkably low, [particularly in Chicago](https://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=lDfd4UgWnXPwo2ptbZtw3ijOVK8NC9t2jvYA5ReWYY_ByZxb5zaPFPg02rmW3A_85apHJOCwVwEBWkMPsFm7IVYZ7E9ujaiws6u98h7zWbkAbB8rb1oZ-GsW0HxtX-VmwLdTUdp37_6VDYOqjgalEQ&e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=6_23_newsletter&n=3). Local and state elections are extremely important because they affect what happens close to home, especially when it comes to our governor. The lockdowns, mask mandates, and business shutdowns that disrupted our lives over the past two years came from the governor’s office. So it’s extremely important that we get out and vote, because only Gary has what it takes to beat Pritzker and fix our state! Take the time to plan how you’re going to vote. Early in-person voting is available right now at early voting locations. June 27th is the last day for early, in-person voting. On Election Day, the polls are open from 6 a.m. to 7 p.m. for in person voting and for dropping off mail-in ballots. Make sure you’re registered to vote; if you aren’t, you can register in-person at an early voting location. Also make sure you know your polling location: you can find it online with [this link](https://rabineforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=elD9XTCGokErxnL1zTyPGnPa8Sjwt0_DQzmyKr13vSk4tCwBNoJ4OqTC6E74jgGUFhs5brFK5PQOsn1pN0Cspg&e=97dbce03af6e3b5efee34e9cd7c37776&utm_source=rabineforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=6_23_newsletter&n=4). You can also vote by mail if you requested a mail-in ballot. Share this information with eligible friends, family, and coworkers. Voting is how we can make our voices heard. Choose the one candidate who will fight and win for us: vote for Gary Rabine! Best regards, The Rabine Team

We've missed our endorsement goal. Please send your endorsement today. It’s Rep. Jim Jordan. We were just reviewing our records and noticed your status is still pending. Will you please confirm before midnight tonight?

| [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=0db41625dd854475ac82ddb0226c8113&_e=M890GbL6Tzf6Z5Rk8POV3nfmSK9knPwvCNy7z5kP_WZBKBs1frDOh7u-sWwwtkXEp0bkVjk3UCfXr-NcbTCTqxg9Cg99ACcp0Bgl0b3idmr-5kuz-UZNk4GYVwxnkpZDSaOuFadT_TSwpcknh6MgMfknVCvWBQ1bs-NFvNjZuj2WREkkUdvPJy8e0RkU7_b7R7HJfCvEhx4x_VqS2hyVGhTfx9YIhHnUwvtz0WLbIyO4bUvTVgte74Zm_i0V93VVO3OIr-Y4GKVbu3UcL8x5tzKfXGvQ2APuqE26a6GFh2AAkf-VYH2lDywUl0JavTyiuFSiQFf-Cgh4u31eFxK7mvEqsrEds82kH6H7-OJ_oTUy0yd0KYAvbiPGgEsx2_zV)

Peter,

Though we posted strong numbers in our primary election on May 3rd, **we did not reach our goal of picking up the 20,000 endorsements we set out to collect ahead of the vote**.

Some say that our district should be safe for Republicans in November, but with almost half the district as “new territory”, we are not taking any chances. **The way people lose is to forget who they are, where they come from and who they represent.** I’ve seen former colleagues make this mistake before; I made a vow to myself to never become complacent.

So, here we are once again, **five months until Election Day,** and if we learned anything from the Supreme Court leak last week, the entire political landscape can be changed by a single event.

I’m gearing up for the election to safe this country, and **[I would truly appreciate seeing your name on the list of supporters who have personally endorsed me for reelection.](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=0db41625dd854475ac82ddb0226c8113&_e=M890GbL6Tzf6Z5Rk8POV3nfmSK9knPwvCNy7z5kP_WZBKBs1frDOh7u-sWwwtkXEp0bkVjk3UCfXr-NcbTCTqxg9Cg99ACcp0Bgl0b3idmr-5kuz-UZNk4GYVwxnkpZDSaOuFadT_TSwpcknh6MgMfknVCvWBQ1bs-NFvNjZuj0Qf7u1JwJ23pnmT30a0brPFQrPSVPK-_qUAdsR6dhYwCuvt9XZVrnCgNWdc577SzNmusYViCg23zqqePV2dgCaLHzHyUawXAim0CAT4P5wxemXApuYiUqAbwQj1zkaqRWk8B4SvGFV1KwIb1Yt5Hh4VF7aerXL25wGDXPBaWYE-Yfb3SHGBAViqGCw_EV6C6nzPmqaHIHTukcJW3zKmies)** I’m asking if you have the time, please consider doing so today.

subject: Today’s Supreme Court decision

body:
Friends,
Today, the Supreme Court struck down New York State’s concealed carry law, making it easier for potentially dangerous people to carry firearms in public.
This ruling—a product of the Supreme Court’s ultra-conservative majority and the gun lobby’s chokehold over our politics—puts lives at risk in New York and across our country.
According to the Gun Violence Archive [https://www.gunviolencearchive.org/] , nearly 21,000 people have died in the United States due to gun violence— this year alone . That includes over 150 children.
And since the start of this year, there have already been over 250 reported mass shootings—an average of more than one per day.
Let me be clear: The last thing we should be doing in the midst of a gun violence epidemic is making it harder for cities and states to protect public safety.
But remember: Tonight, the Senate passed the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act. It’s not perfect—but it marks the most significant gun safety legislation in nearly 30 years. The bill includes many of the commonsense measures we’ve worked on for years, like closing the boyfriend loophole, strengthening background checks, and providing significant funding for mental health services. It also includes provisions from my anti-gun trafficking bill, finally making gun trafficking a federal crime—something I’ve fought for for over a decade.
Today is a reminder that progress is rarely linear. Progress and setbacks often go hand-in-hand. We have so much work to do to keep our communities safe.
I promise to not let up the fight—and I’m grateful to know you’re with me.
Sending love and strength,
Kirsten
